response_variable: aboveground forest biomass (Mg/ha) from management inventory plots aggregated to 1-km pixels
predictor_sources: MODIS MAIAC reflectance (9 vars); WorldClim2/Global-PET climate; MODIS cloud cover; SRTM DEM (topography); HWSD soil
data_quality_controls: pixel filtering: <89% Landsat tree cover removed; pixels with <3 plots removed; forest loss >5% or fire 2000-2012 removed; MODIS best-quality flags (AOD/BRF); spectral outliers >10 SD removed (90 pixels); standardized AGB allometry (plot error ~15%)
notes: Spatial K-fold = hierarchical clustering (complete linkage) of coordinates, cluster height H=150 km (slightly > AGB autocorrelation range ~120 km). Also buffered LOO 0-150 km (10-km steps, 100 test pixels x 10 reps). 113 logging concessions in 5 central African countries; 191,563 plots -> 59,857 pixels -> 28,225 after filtering. Field data period 2000-2010 (span inclusive). Study area km2 not reported; scale coded national = sub-continental multi-country extent.

response_variable: Diplodia sapinea infection of Pinus radiata trees (infected/non-infected)

data_quality_controls: 3 observations with missing values removed; tree age imputed and trimmed at 40 yr to reduce outliers
notes: Basque Country. 223 infected vs 703 non-infected. Nested CV: 5-fold x 100 repetitions for performance, 5-fold inner tuning (random search). k-means coordinate clustering (sperrorest/mlr). Surveys 2009-2012 (year a predictor).

response_variable: hourly near-surface air temperature (deg C), 2013

data_quality_controls: none_reported

response_variable: presence-absence of 14 eucalypt tree species (13 Eucalyptus, 1 Corymbia)

Checkerboard 53 blocks ~83x83 km sized with blockCV spatialAutoRange; 5 folds, 1 external fold held out, internal CV on 4 folds (random = biomod2 default 75/25 repeated 4x; spatial = 4-fold on blocks). Independent = spatially blocked external fold; latitudinal-slice design (2 deg ~222 km, 4 species) tests transfer to other region.

response_variable: land use/land cover (10 classes) from manually digitized training polygons

response_variable: above-ground live woody biomass (Mg/ha), Baccini et al. 2012 map aggregated to 1 km (simulated population)

response_variable: daily maximum 8-h average ozone (ppb), 2011

response_variable: tree species per pixel (semantic segmentation) from visually interpreted polygons

response_variable: above-ground biomass (Mg/ha), CCI-Biomass 2017 v3 map as population; also SoilGrids OCS 0-30 cm

response_variable: log10 saturated hydraulic conductivity Ksat (cm/day), lab and field

response_variable: corn grain yield (bu/ac) from combine yield monitor, cleaned and kriged to 2.5 m grid, 2021

response_variable: simulated species abundance counts (Poisson-binomial with spatially autocorrelated effect)

response_variable: landslide occurrence (1460 mapped landslides vs non-landslide points)

response_variable: seabed sediment grain-size class (Folk-based schemes) from grab samples

Samples 2015-2016.

response_variable: synthetic surface chlorophyll a (log10 mg m-3) at real in situ locations/dates

response_variable: landslide occurrence (2312 landslides + 2312 random non-landslide points)

notes: Liangshan Prefecture, Sichuan. RESDC landslide inventory (as of 2019). Data first split 70/30 randomly; both random 10-fold CV and k-means (k=10) spatial CV were applied to the 30% validation subset (~1387 points).

response_variable: mean annual burned area (km2) per 0.1 deg cell from MODIS MCD45A1 (Apr 2000-Mar 2016)

notes: Cells that burned at least once in 2000-2016 (n=3700). sperrorest k-means on coordinates, 5x10-fold for both schemes. Second response (fire occurrence counts) also modelled.

response_variable: presence of sea star Odontaster validus (presence-only + background)
predictor_sources: 16 environmental descriptors at 0.1 deg (Fabri-Ruiz et al. 2017; e.g. depth, sea ice, seafloor conditions)
data_quality_controls: presences filtered to one per 0.1 deg pixel; background one per pixel and restricted to <1500 m depth; KDE target-background correction for sampling bias; collinear predictors removed (VIF>5, rs>0.85)
notes: Southern Ocean south of 45S (country_iso3 NA). 309 non-duplicate presences + 1000 background. BLOCK = 4 groups by median lat/long (Muscarella et al. 2014), 3 train/1 test; also CLOCK 2/3/4-fold longitudinal partitions; 100 replicates. BRT (gbm.step).

response_variable: crop yield (soy, maize, sunflower) from combine-harvester yield monitor, kriged to yield maps
predictor_sources: UAV RGB orthoimagery
data_quality_controls: yield-monitor cleaning: removed start/end-of-pass points, lowest 10% grain flow, crossing trajectories; moisture standardisation; orthomosaic QA (reprojection error 0.121 px); overlapping samples removed between train/validation in SCV
notes: patchCROP experiment (70 ha, 30 fields ~0.5 ha); 6 fields (3 crops x 2) used; 4761 overlapping 224x224 px patches per field (81 non-overlapping); 4 equal-size spatial blocks within field, block size not stated; external test on another field of same crop; RCV run with and without overlapping samples; season 2020

response_variable: drainage fraction simulated by MIKE SHE groundwater model (100 m cells)
predictor_sources: topography; geology/hydrogeology; soil maps; precipitation; land use
data_quality_controls: lakes, urban areas, forests and streams masked; negative recharge days set to zero; sub-basin artefact (<100 cells) discarded
notes: Storaa catchment ~1000 km2; random forest metamodel; 9 sub-basins (SAGA watershed delineation) held out in turn; hyperparameters by 5-fold CV on 80% random subset; model outputs 2000-2006; OOB also reported

response_variable: on-road PM2.5 concentration (mobile low-cost sensor, 100 m road segments)
predictor_sources: OpenStreetMap land use in buffers (25-500 m); ambient air-quality station PM2.5; temperature; RH
data_quality_controls: RH adjustment and gravimetric calibration of low-cost sensors (208 filter samples); co-location with reference monitors; sensor QC procedures
notes: Taipei, Osaka, Seoul downtown areas 26.5-46.0 km2 each; campaigns 2018 (Taipei, Osaka) and 2019 (Seoul), <2 weeks each; spatial scheme = 50-fold CV with 100 m exclusion buffer (Pohjankukka et al. 2017); buffer chosen by preliminary sensitivity analysis to keep training size; n_observations derived from mean train+test sizes (972+1458+1314); 5-fold CV also reported for first-stage model

response_variable: synthetic species abundance (simulated) and above-ground biomass (Brazilian Amazon AGB map, 1 km)
predictor_sources: synthetic GRF/MRF covariates; 28 environmental covariates (climate, topography, remote sensing)
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: methodological study (DA-CV); simulated sampling: 1000 samples from 1-100 of 100 k-means subregions, 10 repeats per clustering level; spatial = spatial+ CV (hierarchical-clustering blocks + cluster ensemble) and kNNDM; true error computed exhaustively over all raster cells; AGB raster 1642x928 km cells; covariate detail in Appendix 1

response_variable: tree species (13 classes) from field plots
predictor_sources: Formosat-2 annual image time series (8 m)
data_quality_controls: MACCS atmospheric correction and cloud detection; gap filling; forest mask with stable stands; homogeneous plot centres; GPS 3-5 m
notes: 24x24 km scene near Toulouse; SVM; each iteration tests one pixel per class (13), repeated 50 times; LOO-CV with same training size via random undersampling; buffer from Moran I correlograms (I=0.2); years 2006-2014; class sizes 50-211

response_variable: maize yield (t/ha) from combine-harvester yield sensor

notes: three parcels (18.0 ha) near Koska, 2023 season; 1566 samples before cleaning, 1031 after (749+188+94); RF and BGLM; CAST k-means on coordinates

response_variable: oak dieback status of forest plots (healthy vs declining; optional very declining)

notes: Centre-Val de Loire, 11 S2 tiles (~110000 km2; national scale by area >100000 km2, subnational region); ~2700 plots of 20 trees labelled 2017-2022; plot pixels used as samples; SLOO-CV with 10 km buffer (20 km gave similar results), repeated 300 times per labelling year; leave-one-year-out forecasting test also reported; 3-class results also given

response_variable: landslide presence/absence (743 landslides from Tropical Cyclone Cempaka 2017)

response_variable: daily mean, minimum and maximum ambient air temperature at weather stations (stage 2); MODIS LST gap-filling (stage 1)

notes: 43 European countries (EU + Iceland, UK, Switzerland, Norway, Balkans); 2003-2020; n_sites = mean stations per year for Tmean (4474 Tmin, 4634 Tmax); stage 2 blocks 125x125 km x 30 days from variograms; stage 1 LST: 500x500 km x 10 days blocks, 5-fold, with random within-block validation

response_variable: glacier vs non-glacier pixels from National Glacier Inventory 2017-2018 outlines

notes: nine Peruvian cordilleras modelled separately (42135 km2 of composites); balanced stratified training sample (1000 pixels per region per variogram caption) and 1000 simple-random test pixels per region as reference error; RF, GBM, KNN, LR; indicator variograms reported

response_variable: wildfire presence/absence (CAL FIRE perimeters 2016-2024 converted to points)

response_variable: gully presence/absence

response_variable: gully presence/absence (4020 gully polygons rasterised to 25 m)

notes: Heihe region, Heilongjiang; up to 5000 positive cells with 1:2 positive:negative ratio (exact n not stated); leave-one-district-out over 6 districts; gully imagery 2023 (Sentinel-2, Gaofen-1/2); hyperparameters by 5-fold CV on training set; RF, XGBoost, GBM, LR

notes: two LDSF sentinel sites (Sinfra 2018, Vavoua 2019), 10x10 km each, 16 clusters x 10 plots = 160 plots per site; n_sites = 32 clusters (location grouping for LLOCV not stated explicitly); 80% calibration with CV, 20% random independent validation

response_variable: soil organic carbon (%) at 0-30 cm (Walkley-Black)

response_variable: reed canarygrass presence/absence in forest understorey plots

notes: Upper Mississippi River floodplain Pools 3-13 (~41000 ha); USACE forest inventory 2008-2019, plots on 100.6 m grid; 1977 presences and 2425 absences; block size from blockCV, folds by spatialsample; BART, boosted trees, RF; spatial CV with Euclidean distance fields also tested

notes: cropland areas of Morocco (MODIS MCD12Q1 2023); classes low, medium, high, not aware; grid blocks of 25, 50 and 100 km tested, 50 km reported as intermediate scale; GroupKFold 5 folds; standard CV details (k) not reported; RF, XGBoost, logit, majority baseline

response_variable: soil available nitrogen (kg/ha) in 0-15 cm

notes: Lakhimpur district, Assam (district central rural region 2257 km2; total area not stated); systematic randomised sampling; 128 calibration / 32 validation; spatial 5-fold blocking with blockCV, block size not reported; RF, Cubist, XGBoost, SVM, KNN

response_variable: Regional crop yield (t/ha) of barley, rapeseed, rye, wheat (Czech Statistical Office, NUTS-3)

response_variable: Flood and landslide occurrence (presence vs. random pseudo-absence) for susceptibility

response_variable: Soil class at four Chinese Soil Taxonomy levels (Great Group, Subgroup, Genus, Species) labelled from 1:1,000,000 legacy soil map

response_variable: Cropland topsoil (0-20 cm) soil organic carbon content (g/kg)
predictor_sources: Landsat 8/9 spectral indices and LST; station-interpolated climate (CMA); SRTM DEM terrain; RESDC data
data_quality_controls: Landsat scenes >30% cloud excluded; QA_PIXEL masking; VIF-type iterative covariate removal; preprocessing inside CV pipeline; samples cleaned of debris/residues
notes: Stratified random sampling design (field), but random split not stratified. Random = 100 repeated 80:20 holdouts (248/62); spatial = 5-fold size-constrained k-means CV repeated 20 times, nested 4-fold spatial tuning. TabPFN R2 0.608 random vs 0.535 spatial; also RF, SVM, CatBoost, KNN, XGBoost.

study_area_km2: 1328 (132,813 cells of 100 m; central urban Beijing)
response_variable: Presence of existing park green space in 100 m grid cell (>=50% coverage = positive, 0% = negative)
predictor_sources: DEM elevation; distance to water; population grid; housing prices; nighttime lights; residential and road density; OpenStreetMap POI densities
data_quality_controls: Cloud and cloud-shadow Landsat observations excluded; harmonisation to common 100 m grid; intermediate-coverage cells excluded; class weights computed within training folds
notes: Response labels derived from mapped park green space (not field data). Random = 5 repeated stratified 70/30 splits; spatial = 5-fold GroupKFold on predefined spatial blocks (size not reported). XGBoost spatial ROC-AUC 0.8772. Models LR, DT, RF, GBM, XGBoost. Area derived from cell count.

response_variable: Groundwater delta18O (per mil VSMOW)
predictor_sources: Hydrochemistry (major ions, EC, pH, depth); coordinates (longitude)
data_quality_controls: Mahalanobis-distance outlier removal (4 samples; sensitivity test with/without); z-score standardisation; standard laboratory protocols
notes: El-Minia, mid-Nile Valley (area not reported). Random 70/30 split with CV tuning on training set, plus LOOCV; spatial = grouped folds on 4 longitude bins. RF R2 0.83 random vs 0.50 spatial; Lasso 0.81 vs 0.45; GBR 0.80 vs 0.41.

response_variable: Farm-record-level hard dry maize yield (t/ha) from ESPAC 2024 agricultural survey
predictor_sources: Survey farm/management/socioeconomic variables; CHIRPS3 precipitation; ERA5-Land temperature and soil moisture (parish level)
block_or_buffer_size: 8-10 parishes per fold (GroupKFold by parish; canton-grouped sensitivity)
data_quality_controls: Exact-duplicate removal (2 records); associated-crop records excluded; predefined yield plausibility audit (3 flagged, sensitivity test); preprocessing within folds
notes: Random record-level CV (5 outer/4 inner shuffled folds) used as diagnostic only. Elastic Net, RF, HistGB vs training-fold mean benchmark; all spatial pooled R2 negative. Field coordinates unavailable, so no distance blocking.

response_variable: Short-term sidewalk PM2.5 and PM1 concentrations (10 s and 1 min) from mobile monitoring
predictor_sources: Street-view video visual features; audio features; meteorology; background PM from fixed stations; buffer-based geospatial context (100-500 m)
n_observations: ~107,000 valid 5 s data points (aggregated to 10 s and 1 min)
block_or_buffer_size: 3 route-based zones; 100 x 100 m grids (204 cells) grouped into 5 folds
data_quality_controls: Data cleaning; sensor calibration against regulatory-grade instrument (8 regression formulas); trained walkers with standardised protocol
notes: Shenzhen CBD (area not reported; 31.4 km walking route), scale assumed field. Random = 5-fold CV repeated 5 times plus Monte Carlo 50 x 80/20 splits; spatial = leave-one-zone-out (3 zones) and 5-fold grid-based CV (10 s only). LightGBM 1 min R2 0.80 random vs 0.41-0.48 spatial. Exploratory 5-class classification with stratified 80/20 split only (not compared spatially). Mobile sensor data coded as in_situ_samples.

response_variable: Land-cover class (ESA WorldCover 2021 labels, 9 classes)
predictor_sources: AlphaEarth foundation-model embeddings (Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Landsat, LiDAR); Sentinel-2 spectral baseline
data_quality_controls: Equal-allocation stratified sampling (3000 per class; 2 rare classes below quota); semivariogram/Moran's I check of block size; design weighting to national strata
notes: RF on 64-D embeddings. Random stratified 5-fold OA 0.859 vs spatially blocked 5-fold OA 0.815 (20 block-to-fold assignments). Independent stratified probability sample of 400 points (388 usable) interpreted from VHR imagery. Labels are an existing map product (WorldCover).

response_variable: Snow avalanche occurrence (release-zone centroids vs. random non-avalanche points)
predictor_sources: SRTM DEM terrain; ECMWF snowfall/temperature/precipitation; glacier inventory; faults and earthquakes; Landsat NDVI and land use
data_quality_controls: 500 m exclusion buffer for non-avalanche points; normalisation; avalanche polygons interpreted from field survey and imagery
notes: Inventory from field surveys (spring 2025), remote sensing interpretation and historical records (data_source mixed). Random stratified 70/30 split with 5-fold CV tuning; spatial = 5-fold CV over 25 coordinate k-means blocks. RF AUC 0.912 random vs 0.850 spatial; SVM 0.855 spatial.

response_variable: Landslide occurrence (landslide vs. non-landslide, mapped on optimised slope units)
predictor_sources: Multi-resolution DEM terrain; GF-2 and Sentinel-2 imagery; geological maps (lithology, faults); hydrological data; land use/NDVI
data_quality_controls: 200 m exclusion buffer around landslides for non-slide sampling; stratified random non-slide sampling; multicollinearity screening of factors; field verification of inventory
notes: Zhenping County, Shaanxi. Inventory from historical data, GF-2/Sentinel-2 interpretation and field investigation. Random = 70/30 split at polygon scale; spatial = 5-fold leave-one-block-out (Roberts et al. blocking) repeated 5 times. LMT-RSM spatial AUC 0.954 +/- 0.019; LMT 0.925; AdaBoost-LMT 0.934.

response_variable: Rainfed wheat grain yield from crop cuts (t/ha, 12% moisture)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-1; Sentinel-2 biophysical, biochemical, phenological and structural metrics
data_quality_controls: Removal of mis-georeferenced points and points outside wheat mask; IQR outlier removal; duplicate/misaligned record removal; area of applicability (AOA) analysis
notes: Ensemble ML (RF, XGBoost etc.). Random 70:30 split R2 0.56 vs spatial block CV (blockCV, 1 km blocks) R2 0.29; stratified CV R2 0.41. Number of spatial folds not reported. Multi-stage stratified field sampling design.

response_variable: Any-event PFAS detection at drinking-water sampling locations (UCMR5)
predictor_sources: SDWIS system attributes; ACS 2018-2022 community data; proximity to military installations, airports, TRI/ECHO/SEMS/FRS facilities
data_quality_controls: Completeness rule (>=4 events surface water, >=2 otherwise; 8.1% locations excluded); temporal-provenance audit removed 25 post-sampling predictors; preprocessing fitted within folds
notes: LightGBM. Random CV grouped by PWS (non-spatial 10-fold) AUROC 0.741 vs leave-one-state-block-out 0.625; HUC-2 sensitivity (22 folds). Block prevalence 4.4-37.9%. UCMR5 records as of Jan 2026. Lab water samples coded as in_situ_samples.

response_variable: Wildfire vs. non-wildfire label of VIIRS SNPP thermal anomaly detections (matched to NIFC 2024 perimeters, 1 km buffer)
predictor_sources: VIIRS radiometric attributes (FRP, brightness, confidence); temporal features; spatiotemporal clustering; geographic coordinates
spatial_k: 1 (80/20 block holdout; 5 block-to-fold assignments in sensitivity)
data_quality_controls: Label-buffer sensitivity (0.5-5 km); candidate-negative composition audit; causal (trailing-window) clustering to avoid temporal leakage; balanced test sets
notes: CONUS. Four regimes at 80/20: random stratified (LightGBM F1 0.985), event-aware grouped (0.767), 5-deg spatial block (0.627; 0.818 without coordinates), temporal Jan-Aug vs Sep-Dec. Block-size sensitivity 2.5, 5, 10 deg.

response_variable: 13-class land-use/land-cover including Pteridium arachnoideum and Tithonia diversifolia
predictor_sources: Planet NICFI monthly composites 2023 (4 bands, 4.77 m)
block_or_buffer_size: 5 per-class k-means coordinate clusters pooled into folds
data_quality_controls: Best-pixel monthly composites minimising cloud; field reconnaissance plus visual interpretation of samples; equal samples per class; class weights per fold
notes: Brazil Federal District (area not reported). Random = 60/20/20 train/validation/test stratified, 5 seeds; spatial = 5-fold CV on geographically disjoint regions (test 1976-4588 samples), inner random 75/25 train/validation. 43 DL architectures; F1 >98% random vs ~82% spatial (16-25 pp inflation).

response_variable: household F. hepatica infection presence (human and sheep, stool microscopy) aggregated to hexagonal cells
predictor_sources: UAV multispectral; UAV thermal; UAV DEM; TerraClimate (downscaled)
data_quality_controls: field SOPs, staff retraining and periodic data audits for inconsistencies
notes: 61 households for human model (21.3% positive); sheep model separate; neighbouring hexagons grouped into 3 spatial folds each with >=1 positive; hexagon size not stated in text; nested Optuna tuning

response_variable: annual district temperature anomaly
predictor_sources: NASA POWER climate; EDGAR emissions; MODIS/AVHRR vegetation; PBS census population
data_quality_controls: temporal alignment; linear interpolation of gaps <=3 yr; outliers beyond +/-4 SD removed; zero-variance features removed
notes: Leave-One-District-Out CV (22 districts x 44 years 1981-2024); temporal test 2020-2024 (110 samples); temporally blocked CV also reported

response_variable: InSAR vertical land subsidence velocity (TRE ALTAMIRA Sentinel-1 SqueeSAR maps, 2018-2020 mean)
predictor_sources: pumping (C2VSimFG); GRACE GWSA; TerraClimate precipitation; USGS compressible layer; MODIS land cover; road/river distance
data_quality_controls: invalid values and extreme outliers removed; resampling to 1 km; scaling refitted within training folds
notes: California Central Valley; 1 km grid cells; 616 spatial blocks of 10 km in GroupKFold (5 folds); hyperparameters tuned with 5-fold shuffled KFold inside training; residual Moran's I reported

response_variable: landslide/collapse occurrence (presence vs pseudo-absence)
predictor_sources: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 derivatives; geology/lithology/faults; precipitation dataset; Landsat 8/9 NDWI/NDVI; MODIS LULC; roads/rivers/mines distance
data_quality_controls: non-landslide points sampled outside 1 km buffer of landslides and outside water bodies; Spearman/VIF/IG factor screening
notes: 625 hazard sites from 2022 Xinjiang Geohazard Risk Census + 625 random non-landslide points (1:1); repeated random resampling also reported (number of repeats not stated in text); K-means spatial clusters with GroupKFold, number of clusters/folds not stated in text; Chinese Altai Mountains

response_variable: daily PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations (summer)
predictor_sources: Landsat 8/9 indices; MAIAC AOD; TROPOMI S5P trace gases; ERA5; ASTER DEM; GIS land use/road layers
data_quality_controls: Landsat QA_PIXEL cloud screening plus visual check; MAIAC QA filtering; PM10 extreme outliers (3xIQR) sensitivity analysis; stations with <6 valid obs excluded from LOSO; no imputation
notes: Tehran; 989 PM2.5 + 557 PM10 daily records (summers 2022-2025); 31/18 stations used; block size set to give ~k^2 blocks, grouped into 5 contiguous folds by agglomerative clustering (3,4,6 folds sensitivity); LOSO-CV also reported; random K not stated

response_variable: land-cover/vegetation class (19 classes, Matiwan Village airborne HSI)
predictor_sources: airborne hyperspectral imagery (250 bands, 0.5 m)
data_quality_controls: per-class sample capping/subsampling to balance classes; buffer of >=8 px (patch radius) between blocks
notes: Single scene 3750x1580 px at 0.5 m (Xiong'an New Area); LFBP blocks 32x128 px with train/val/test 1500/500/500 per class after balancing (raw class sizes highly imbalanced, 3.34 M labelled px); random pixel partition compared with same training config, its split ratio not stated; 5 random seeds

response_variable: winter oilseed rape dry seed yield (combine yield monitor, t/ha)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 monthly NDVI
data_quality_controls: yield monitor preprocessing/filtering; yields >10 t/ha removed as implausible; cloud-free Sentinel-2 only; median imputation of NDVI fitted on training subset
notes: 8 commercial fields (6.9-62.5 ha, ~224 ha total) spread across central Lithuania, 2023-2024 season; field-wise GroupSplit ~80% fields train/20% test, repeated 20 times with GroupShuffleSplit; study_area = summed field area

response_variable: landslide occurrence (Sentinel-2 interpreted inventory centroids vs pseudo-absences)
predictor_sources: SRTM DEM derivatives; Sentinel-2 NDVI; land cover; lithology; CHIRPS precipitation; HydroRIVERS; OpenStreetMap roads
data_quality_controls: landslide interpretations cross-checked with Google Earth/multi-source imagery; pseudo-absences outside 500 m buffer with 90 m minimum spacing; buffer/ratio/seed sensitivity
notes: Hualong and Xunhua counties (Qinghai); 281 landslides + 281 pseudo-absences; 10x10 km blocks (59 occupied) in 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold; block-size sensitivity 5/10/15 km; cross-county transfer Hualong<->Xunhua

response_variable: mean crown defoliation of European beech per survey point and year (WZE forest condition survey)
predictor_sources: climate (evaporation, radiation, temperature, SPEI); EU-DEM topography; SoilGrids; UFZ soil moisture; vegetation variables
data_quality_controls: pure beech points verified on orthophotos (conifer-containing points excluded); residual Moran's I check of grid size
notes: Schleswig-Holstein, Lower Saxony and Hesse, 2016-2022; LOLO over 56 occupied 30x30 km grid cells (test n 0-~200); LOYO train 2016-2021 (2470) test 2022 (416); tuning with 5 shuffled splits inside training

response_variable: occurrence of an endangered montane conifer (field RTK-GNSS presences vs random background)
predictor_sources: UAV-LiDAR structural metrics and DEM derivatives; vegetation indices; HWSD soil type
data_quality_controls: spatial deduplication to one record per 20 m cell (140->134); Pearson/multicollinearity screening; LiDAR point-cloud noise removal and coverage check
notes: 134 presences after deduplication plus random background points (number not stated in text); 10 repeated stratified random validation runs (split ratio not stated); leave-one-block-out over 4 k-means blocks; field surveys 2021 and 2022

response_variable: simulated virtual-species-like response from bioclimatic PCA (values 0-1)
predictor_sources: WorldClim 19 bioclimatic variables
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: Meyer & Pebesma AOA preprint (2020); response simulated over Europe so country left NA; case study: 10 points clustered around each of 50 locations; random 10-fold CV RMSE 0.021 vs leave-cluster-out 0.039; true values known everywhere (RMSPE against full simulated surface)

response_variable: biome class (BIOME 6000 pollen-based site reconstructions)
predictor_sources: 160 global layers: climate (CHELSA/WorldClim bioclim, precipitation, temperature); MODIS cloud fraction; DEM derivatives; lithology
data_quality_controls: most frequently reconstructed biome per site; tropics supplemented with 350 simulated points and RADAM Brazil pseudo-observations; GBIF tree records filtered by coordinate uncertainty <2 km
notes: Hengl et al. 2018 PeerJ PNV; random vs spatial comparison only for biomes (accuracy 68% vs 33%); spatial = mlr SpRepCV 5 folds x 5 reps; tree-taxa (1.5 M occurrences) and FAPAR (~30k points) models validated only with random repeated CV

response_variable: landslide occurrence (scarp points vs random non-landslide points)
predictor_sources: ALS-DTM (10 m) terrain derivatives; lithology; land cover
data_quality_controls: ALS inventory mapped from 1 m shaded relief/orthophotos with field checks of positional accuracy; BGR records cross-checked in field
notes: Flysch Zone of Lower Austria (Steger et al. 2016); two inventories modelled separately: ALS-based (6,218 points; n given = ALS landslides + equal non-landslides) and Building Ground Registry (545 training landslides = 80%); spatial CV = 10 subregions per repetition repeated 50 times (partitioning method not named in text)

response_variable: daily PM2.5 concentration at EPA AQS monitors
predictor_sources: MAIAC AOD (AERONET-corrected); meteorology; NLCD developed area; NDVI; elevation; PM2.5 point emissions; IDW of monitors
data_quality_controls: atypical point-source monitor dropped; duplicate site-days within same 1 km cell removed (n=4533); AOD corrected with AERONET; IDW features computed fold-wise to avoid leakage
notes: 13-state Northeastern USA 2000-2015 (Just et al. 2020); spatial CV = single-link hierarchical clusters of monitors cut at 31 km (median distance from 1 km grid centroids to nearest monitor), assigned to 10 folds; site-wise CV also reported; random 10-fold RMSE 2.10 vs spatial 3.11

response_variable: grassland above-ground biomass and plant species richness (plot clipping and inventories)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 time series and vegetation indices; Sentinel-1 backscatter; topo-edaphic variables (soil type, slope, aspect)
data_quality_controls: plots with trees inside/near borders removed; standardized sampling protocol; Sentinel-2 <50% cloud and April-October only; Moran's I test on observations
notes: Biodiversity Exploratories (ALB, HAI, SCH), May 2017-2020; baseline is group 5-fold CV keeping plot replicates together (iterated 10x); spatial = leave-one-exploratory(region)-out; 40 extra biomass samples from June/Sep 2020 used as independent phenological test; AOA computed

response_variable: climate at modern pollen sites (July temperature; January temperature / water balance) from CRU CL 2.0 grids
predictor_sources: modern pollen assemblages (North American Modern Pollen Database; European Modern Pollen Dataset)
data_quality_controls: floristically different regions removed (SE US, western N America); harmonized taxonomy; CRU climate lapse-rate corrected to site elevation
notes: Salonen et al. 2019; separate calibration sets North America (2254 samples) and Europe (807); h-block CV with h from 0 (=LOO) to 1500 km in 100 km steps, preferred h 200-600 km from residual variogram range; fossil sequences used for palaeo-reconstruction plausibility (not error estimation)

response_variable: species occurrence (171 species; presence-background training, independent presence-absence survey testing)
predictor_sources: NCEAS/disdat regional covariates (climate, rainfall, soil class, terrain; ~100-1000 m grids)
data_quality_controls: target-group background to address sampling bias; species with <5 presences per training fold or <10 test presences excluded; some covariates excluded
notes: Valavi et al. 2023 GEB; six regions (AWT, Ontario, NE NSW, New Zealand, five South American countries, Switzerland); blockCV ~75x75 km blocks randomly allocated to 5 folds; random partition subsampled to match spatial fold sizes; evaluation always on independent presence-absence survey data; most data 1950-2000

response_variable: grassland above-ground biomass dry weight (quadrat clipping)
predictor_sources: MODIS VIs (NDVI, EVI, SAVI, MSAVI, OSAVI), LAI, LST, ET/PET; DEM (altitude, slope, aspect); interpolated meteorology (accumulated temperature, precipitation)
data_quality_controls: 3-5 quadrats per site averaged; samples oven-dried to constant weight; forward feature selection to remove variables causing spatial overfitting
notes: Tibetan Plateau 2001-2018 (Yu et al. 2021); 3636 field sites + 146 sites from Xia et al. 2018; LLO-CV folds split by longitude/latitude (3 folds for FFS, 10-fold for final model); random CV fold number not stated; study area 257.24x10^4 km2 as reported

response_variable: crop type (11 major crops, 2018) from LPIS/IACS farmer declarations
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 time series (MAJA, interpolated bi-weekly); Sentinel-1 SAR time series
data_quality_controls: 10 m negative parcel buffer to exclude border pixels; no train/test overlap at parcel level; sampling adjusted for parcel size; cloud/shadow masking and temporal interpolation of optical data
notes: Seven Sentinel-2 tiles (109.8x109.8 km) across Germany (Orynbaikyzy et al. 2022); 500 px per crop per site by stratified random sampling, 60/40 train/test within sites (reference system) vs 7-fold leave-one-site-out (target system); spatial forward feature selection also tested

response_variable: Chl-a of 8 phytoplankton groups from HPLC pigments (DPA)
predictor_sources: OC-CCI ocean colour (Rrs, IOPs, Chl, Kd490, water class); PAR; CMEMS biogeochemical and physical reanalysis; wind; spatiotemporal terms
data_quality_controls: samples <10 m depth only; pigments <0.001 mg m-3 rejected; pre-1997 excluded; duplicates averaged; 1-day/3x3-pixel matchups
notes: Global compiled HPLC dataset (Kramer & Siegel 2021 + open data + 405 East China Sea cruise samples), 1997-2020; random 5-fold stratified by 14 optical water classes (Kennard-Stone 4:1); spatial block 5-fold with two zonings: 11 ocean basins and 20-deg hexagons (180 regions); also temporal block 5-fold CV; independent validation at six long-term time-series sites (MVCO, CARIACO, PAB, Yongala, Port Hacking, Maria Island); total matchup N only shown in Fig. 3; STEE ensemble (GBM, 1d-CNN, TabNet)

response_variable: Spectral AOD (0.44, 0.675 um) and Angstrom exponent (AERONET)
predictor_sources: Himawari-8 AHI L1B TOA reflectance (0.46, 0.64, 2.3 um) and differential operator; sun/sensor geometry; clear-sky AOD reference; clustered aerosol models; location and date
data_quality_controls: AERONET V3 Level 2.0 quality-assured data; AERONET averaged within +/-30 min of AHI time; cloudy pixels removed with Himawari L2 cloud product; 5x5-pixel window
notes: AHI full-disk domain (80E-160W, 60N-60S; East Asia and Oceania), year 2018; random sample-based 10-fold CV; site-based 10-fold CV (10% of AERONET sites withheld per fold); number of AERONET sites only in Appendix Fig. A1; RF (DORF)

response_variable: Actual evapotranspiration of grasslands (flux towers)
predictor_sources: In situ meteorology (Tmax, Tmin, Tmean, Prcp, rH, WS, SWI, Rn, SWC, Tsoil); MODIS NDVI, NDWI, LAI, FPAR; HWSD soil; elevation
data_quality_controls: flux data post-processed and gap-filled (REddyProc); days with >20% low-confidence gap-filled data excluded; clearly erroneous periods removed by visual check; MODIS QA flags
notes: Arid and semi-arid Northern China grasslands (Tibetan Plateau, Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang), 15 towers (14 EC, 1 BREB), records 2002-2019; random CV used same k as spatial (k = number of sites; 15 for pooled model, fewer for alpine/temperate models); four temporal resolutions (daily, 8-day, monthly, seasonal); RF; area not reported

response_variable: Burn severity class (dNBR-derived, USGS thresholds)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 L2A bands (10) and 225 derived spectral indices
data_quality_controls: two-step cloud filtering (scene cloud <=15%, pixel cloud probability >65% masked); core sampling within 25th-75th dNBR percentiles; small patches and isolated pixels removed
notes: 2022 Uljin wildfire, Uljin County; 1000 stratified points per severity class; random 3000/2000 split (60/40); ninefold spatial CV with nine non-overlapping spatial patches (patch size not reported); RF with SHAP-forward stepwise selection

response_variable: Relative concentrations of 8 phytoplankton diagnostic pigments (HPLC, SeaBASS)
predictor_sources: MODIS-Aqua Chl-a, Rrs and band slopes, Kd490, PAR; MUR SST; sea level anomaly; wind speed and stress; day of year
data_quality_controls: SeaBASS QC; depth >10 m removed; within 50 km of land removed; one observation per station-day (closest to surface); matchups with <3 valid pixels or >20% pixel deviation discarded; Chl-a >3 mg m-3 removed
notes: Open ocean, SeaBASS HPLC 2003-2017 (29,232 raw to 446 matchups); double (nested) spatial block CV with large blocks assigned manually (8-94 observations per block; number of blocks only in Fig. 2); spatial observation weights (200 km radius) from variograms; RF and BRT among other models

response_variable: Daily surface NO2 concentration (EPA AQS)
predictor_sources: PCNN-imputed NO2; OMI and TROPOMI tropospheric NO2 columns; CMAQ NO2; urban fraction; EVI; elevation; NLDAS meteorology; MERRA-2 reanalysis
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: CONUS 2005-2019, 7x5.5 km grid; two-step PCNN-DNN deep learning (one DNN per year); spatial-CV same as 10-CV but folds split by ground station; hourly NO2 averaged to daily; number of stations only in Fig. 1

response_variable: Monthly mean surface NO2 concentration
predictor_sources: OMI NO2 column (RF gap-filled); ERA5 meteorology; ESA CCI land cover; roads (gROADS); lightning flash density; MERRA-2; other ancillary
data_quality_controls: constant NO2 values for >=8 h removed (instrument malfunction); days with <18 hourly values and months with <20 valid days excluded; pre-Sept 2018 values scaled by 0.92; OMI pixels with cloud fraction >30% removed
notes: China, 0.05 deg monthly NO2 2005-2020 (ground network from 2013); ~1,500 CNEMC stations (approximate); spatial 10-fold CV by location (90% of locations for training); also temporal 10-fold, by-year CV, and separate 2020 external validation; ensemble of RF, XGBoost, GBM

response_variable: Daily maximum 8-h average (MDA8) surface ozone
predictor_sources: NLDAS meteorology; TROPOMI total ozone column; weighted average ozone layer; DL-estimated surface NO2; population density; road density; urban fraction; DEM; day of year
data_quality_controls: EPA quality flags used to exclude flagged measurements; VIF-based removal of collinear predictors
notes: CONUS 2019, 4 km Deep-CNN; Spatial-CV identical to 10-CV but samples split randomly by station location (k stated implicitly as same procedure)

response_variable: Log topsoil zinc concentration (Meuse); fruit-tree crop type (Maipo)
predictor_sources: Meuse: elevation, distance to river, UTM coordinates; Maipo: multi-temporal Landsat reflectances (8 dates) and indices
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: Two case studies: Meuse floodplain (Netherlands, ~4 x 1 km, 155 soil samples, regression) and Maipo (central Chile, ~40 km diameter, 400 fields / 7713 grid cells, 4 crops, 100 fields sampled repeatedly with 25 per crop, classification); random and spatial 10-fold CV each repeated 50 times; Maipo also field-level CV and LOO; author argues autocorrelation range is not a suitable criterion for test-set definition; spatial prediction error profiles (SPEPs)

response_variable: Annual average sulfate concentration (salinity proxy) per watershed
predictor_sources: USGS streamflow and groundwater wells; SSURGO soil EC and CaCO3; curve number; PRISM climate; NLCD land cover; DEM; WWTF discharge; agricultural area; location
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: Colorado River Basin, 2000-2020 (described as twenty years), ~150 USGS gauges / watersheds; 11 ML algorithms plus BMA and stacked ensembles; spatial CV with six geographic clusters of watershed coordinates (Euclidean clustering; method named as clustering, not explicitly k-means)

response_variable: Soil organic carbon content by depth (0-100 cm)
predictor_sources: DEM derivatives (relief); bioclimatic variables; MODIS EVI, reflectance bands, LAI/FPAR, GPP, snow cover; ESA land cover; depth
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: Russian Federation (Europe and Asia), Unified State Register of Soils: 4,961 horizons from 863 profiles; spatial 5-fold CV with 150x150 km blocks (blockCV); randomized non-spatial CV reported but number of folds not stated; RF with area of applicability

response_variable: Annual irrigation volume/depth per field (CO) or PLSS section (KS)
predictor_sources: Landsat SSEBop actual ET; irrigated area maps; Landsat spectral indices and neighbourhood greenness; gridMET climate; soils; derived hydrologic variables
data_quality_controls: fields with implausibly high irrigation (>=3 ac-ft/ac) removed (0.77% CO, 0.14% KS); missing data filtered
notes: Republican River Basin, Colorado (22,753 km2, 2015-2018) and western Kansas (85,444 km2, 2000-2016); reference data from well-level pumping records; random accuracy from RF out-of-bag predictions; spatial leave-one-side-out (east/west and north/south halves, train on one half test on the other); also leave-one-year-out CV

response_variable: Daily ultrafine particle number concentration
predictor_sources: MAIAC AOD and Angstrom exponent; meteorology; land use and roads; NO2; PM2.5; calendar terms
data_quality_controls: only best-quality MAIAC AOD (cloud and adjacency masks clear); missing AOD imputed by RF
notes: Central Taiwan (Taichung, Changhua, Nantou), two SMPS campaigns 2008-2010 and 2017-2021 at six sites; 1,022 effective sampling days; XGBoost best; also 10-fold temporal validation; study area km2 not reported

response_variable: Land cover / vegetation community class and foliar vegetation cover (%)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 bands and soil-adjusted indices; MODIS NDSI snow metrics
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: Wakhan, Afghanistan (~200 x 65 km); 423 land cover plots (9 classes) and 186 cover plots from 93 transects; field data 2016 and 2018; spatial 100-repeated 10-fold CV with k-means (sperrorest); non-spatial CV run as the same procedure without spatial partitioning (folds/repeats taken from that statement)

response_variable: Daily snow density
predictor_sources: Passive microwave snow depth; snow cover phenology (SCD, SCOD, SCED, SCE); ERA5-Land snow and meteorological variables; terrain; vegetation; spatiotemporal terms
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: Three stable snow cover areas of China (Xinjiang, Northeast-Inner Mongolia, Qinghai-Tibet Plateau), CMA stations 2013-2018; spatial block CV divides samples by station (number of folds not stated); also temporal block CV (6 years); independent validation with 474 snow-pit/route samples (2017-2018)

response_variable: Presence of submerged aquatic vegetation (SAV vs other)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 surface reflectance; kNDAVI and NDAVI indices; LiDAR and satellite-derived bathymetry
data_quality_controls: Sentinel-2 cloud and shadow masking; sunglint correction; land masked by NDWI; only underwater images rated moderate or good used
notes: Five coastal sites along ~400 km of mid-west Australian coast; GRTS spatially balanced ground truthing from drop-camera imagery (April 2021 imagery); block CV with blockCV: 21 spatial blocks in 5 folds, size from spatialAutoRange (value not reported); also site validation (leave-one-site-out, 5 sites)

response_variable: Sea ice concentration, stage of development and floe size (ice charts)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-1 SAR (HH, HV, incidence angle); AMSR2 brightness temperatures; ERA5 variables; distance to land; geolocation encoding
data_quality_controls: invalid and masked chart pixels excluded; NaN SAR values handled in ready-to-train AutoICE dataset
notes: AutoICE/AI4Arctic benchmark, 533 scenes 2018-2021 over Canadian and Greenlandic Arctic; non-spatial evaluation on benchmark-designated 20 test scenes (487 train, 24 random validation scenes); spatial CV trains on Greenland (302 scenes) and tests on Canada and vice versa (184 scenes); SoD 6 classes, FLOE 7 classes; multi-task DeepLabV3

response_variable: Daily maximum 8-h average ozone
predictor_sources: OMI ozone profile, tropospheric NO2 and HCHO columns; MODIS AOD; ECMWF meteorology and cloud fraction; land use
data_quality_controls: days with <6 h valid ozone set missing; stations in the same 1 km cell averaged; OMI retrievals with ReflectanceCostFunction >30 filtered; missing satellite data imputed by RF
notes: Taiwan 2004-2020, 74 MOE stations, XGBoost; spatial validation is leave-one-site-out; also 10-fold block CV with 25 x 25 km blocks and buffered LOO with 25 km radius; also 10-fold temporal validation

response_variable: Perennial ryegrass dry matter biomass (kg DM/ha)
predictor_sources: Field spectroradiometer reflectance resampled to multispectral bands (Parrot Sequoia); simulated hyperspectral features; vegetation indices
data_quality_controls: standard protocol: clear-sky measurements within +/-2 h of solar noon, randomized plot order
notes: Plot trials at Elliot (Tasmania, 1200 samples) and Goutum, Vredepeel, Zegveld (Netherlands, 216 samples), Dec 2016-Nov 2018; random 75/25 split stratified by location; spatial leave-one-location-out with Elliot subsampled to 72 to balance locations; RF

response_variable: Exchangeable sodium percentage (ESP) at 10-cm depth increments to 100 cm
predictor_sources: Landsat 7 NDVI/red band; airborne radiometrics; DEM-derived terrain; soil class map; geology silica index; climate (ANUCLIM)
data_quality_controls: legacy NSSC + USYD surveys; sites clipped to basin; observations deeper than 100 cm removed; ESP >40% removed as erroneous (270 obs); equal-area spline depth standardisation; cloud masking of Landsat
notes: Sub-continental basin (Murray-Darling, ~1.06 M km2) coded national. Random hold-out 80/10/10 (train/validation/test) by site, partitioned with conditioned Latin hypercube on coordinates and mean ESP (coded stratified=yes). Spatial: leave-one-k-means-cluster-out, 40 clusters chosen by strata and dataset size. Number of depth-level observations not stated. Random hold-out test = the reported 'independent' test; it is a random split, not a probability sample.

response_variable: Presence/pseudo-absence of the pathogen Cytospora chrysosperma
predictor_sources: WorldClim bioclim; elevation/slope/aspect; Landsat NDVI
data_quality_controls: duplicate records within same grid cell removed; field records lab-confirmed; pseudo-absences outside 30 km buffer (sensitivity 20/30/40 km)
notes: Xinjiang province (~1.66 M km2; area not stated in paper) coded regional as subnational unit. 545 presences (368 field 2018-2022, 148 GBIF, 29 literature) + 600 pseudo-absences. Data split 7:3 train/test plus 5-fold CV; conventional results reported on test set. Spatial block CV: 4x4 grid of blocks, 5 folds (blockCV). Bootstrap 1000 for CIs. Five ML models compared.

response_variable: Hourly ground-level PM2.5 concentration
predictor_sources: GOES-16 ABI AOD (gap-filled with GEOS-CF); HRRR meteorology; wavelet components; lat/lon
data_quality_controls: PurpleAir sensors calibrated with GWR; PA dropped where AQS in same 1-km cell; multiple monitors per cell averaged; SMOTE oversampling of high PM2.5
notes: California (subnational, 423,970 km2) coded regional. 104 AQS stations (762,112 hourly obs) + 2980 PurpleAir sensors (9,265,016 hourly obs); May-Dec 2019-2021. Methods describe random 10-fold CV but results report OOB R2 (0.86) vs 10-fold spatial CV by monitor groups (R2 0.82); spatial clustering CV not done because monitors uneven.

response_variable: Satellite column-averaged dry-air CO2 mole fraction (OCO-2 XCO2) gridded at 0.1 deg daily
predictor_sources: CAMS and CarbonTracker XCO2 simulations; ERA5/ERA5-Land meteorology; GLASS FAPAR; GOSIF GPP
block_or_buffer_size: 20 x 30 (lon x lat) per held-out area
data_quality_controls: OCO-2 quality flag = 0 only; outliers beyond 5 SD removed; kriging gap-filling of auxiliary vegetation products
notes: Response is OCO-2 v10 bias-corrected XCO2 retrievals (coded gridded_product). 454,486 matched spatiotemporal samples, 2016-2020. Spatial validation: regional hold-out of three regions (S America 50-70W/20S-10N; Africa 15-35E/10-40N; Asia 100-120E/20-50N) plus inter-continental train/test. Independent ground validation with 24 TCCON stations. Stacking ensemble (RF, DF, ERT, XGB, LGB, CatBoost + ridge).

response_variable: Mass-movement presence/absence (landslide, rockfall, debris flow) on 1-km grid cells
predictor_sources: SRTM DEM terrain; road and river density; soil moisture; lithology (GLiM); land use; geological environment division
data_quality_controls: inventory from national geological hazard survey (image interpretation + field verification + correction); points aggregated to 1-km grid presence; multicollinearity test
notes: Three separate models (landslide 90,558; rockfall 47,057; debris flow 25,425 presence cells) each with 1:1 randomly sampled absences; n_observations = total presence+absence cells over three models. Repeated 10x10-fold spatial and non-spatial CV via sperrorest (GLMM, GAMM) and sklearn (tree-boosted mixed model); spatial partitioning method not described. Inventory known to be spatially incomplete; also tested on simulated biased inventories.

response_variable: Summer daytime land surface temperature (MODIS MOD11A2, downscaled to 30 m)
predictor_sources: Landsat 5/7/8/9 NDVI, NDBI, NDWI, NIRv; SRTM DEM; LST-derived temporal features
data_quality_controls: Landsat QA masking of clouds/shadows; SLC-off gaps reduced by multi-scene compositing; harmonised index definitions across sensors; missing-value filling
notes: Nine core districts of Chongqing (urban). Fixed random train/validation/test split (proportions not reported) vs non-overlapping 10x10 km spatial-block split; temporal hold-out (train 2000-2016, val 2017-2020, test 2021-2024) also reported. Weighted ensemble of RF, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost. Separate check against cloud-free Landsat thermal observations. Sample size not reported.

response_variable: 14-day CO2 fluxes (GEP, TER; NEE derived) from eddy-covariance towers
predictor_sources: Landsat 7/8 and Sentinel-2 indices and LST; CHESS-met/HadGrid climate; COSMOS-UK soil moisture; soil carbon map; land use
data_quality_controls: EC processing in EddyPro; statistical outliers and unfavourable-condition data removed; footprint filter (80% of flux from site); REddyProc gap-filling/partitioning; linear interpolation of gaps after 14-day aggregation
notes: East Anglian Fens agricultural peatlands; 7 flux towers 2009-2023 (6 for training). 5-fold CV on test dataset for GEP/TER; '30% unseen data' stated in Fig. 5 caption (split implied). Spatial validation = single held-out site (Baker's Fen) for NEE only; random vs spatial compare NEE. Number of 14-day samples not reported in main text.

response_variable: Official surface water quality class (I to worse than V) at river monitoring sites
predictor_sources: in situ water quality indicators (WT, pH, DO, EC, CODMn, NH3-N, TP, TN, turbidity)
data_quality_controls: indicators with >70% missingness excluded (Chl-a, algal density); data cleaning; stratified subsampling of 50,000 from 10,159,876 records repeated with 5 seeds
notes: CNEMC online monitoring, ~1900 sites ('approximately'), Jan 2021-Jun 2024, 4-h step. Stratified random 80/20 split (40,000/10,000) x5 seeds; 5-fold stratified CV inside training. Spatial: leave-one-basin-out (9 basins; train 40,000 sampled from 8 basins, test 10,000 from held-out basin). Temporal hold-out at 2024-01-01. Predictors are the same indicators that define the class (single-factor rule), Auto-sklearn vs other ML.

response_variable: Daily outdoor BTEX concentrations (benzene, toluene, ethylbenzene, xylenes)
predictor_sources: land-use map areas; altitude; ERA5 meteorology; TCCIP temperature and precipitation; modelled NO2, O3, PM2.5, SO2; year and day of year
data_quality_controls: instrument calibration/QA plans at PAMS; mobile stations excluded; days with <18 h records excluded; daily outliers >3 SD removed
notes: Taiwan main island (36,193 km2) coded regional. 10 PAMS stations 2011-2020; n_observations = benzene daily records (other species 28,755-29,227). Random 10-fold CV vs spatial 5-fold leave-two-stations-out; also day-of-year temporal CV. Separate RF models per BTEX species.

response_variable: District-level spring wheat yield (t/ha)
predictor_sources: Landsat 7 and Sentinel-2 indices (NDVI, EVI, SAVI, NDWI, NDDI); TerraClimate climate, soil moisture, SWE, solar radiation; SRTM DEM; SoilGrids
data_quality_controls: median imputation of missing/cloud-affected predictor values; spatial averaging within district polygons
notes: Arid steppe zone of Kazakhstan, 17 oblasts, ~22.4 M ha arable land; 2000-2024 district-year panel (n=2628 reported for correlation analysis, assumed full dataset). Yield statistics from national statistics bureau (coded survey_inventory). Random 5-fold CV (R2 0.69) vs 5-fold spatial leave-group-out by district (R2 0.65). Number of districts not reported.

response_variable: Green View Index from street-view image segmentation (Deeplab-v3+)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 NDVI; LAI (Swiss Data Cube); viewshed greenness (LiDAR DSM/DTM); vegetation height model; building/urban form metrics (swissBuildings3D); urban-rural typology
data_quality_controls: spatial filtering: sampling points >=50 m apart; Fmask cloud/shadow masking of Sentinel-2; latest GSV image per location; residual Moran's I checked
notes: Cantons Basel-Stadt and Basel-Landschaft road network (area not stated). 59,647 GSV points thinned to training n=10,590 + test n=1,379 (15 m buffer models); split proportion not reported. 10-fold random CV vs 10-fold block CV (blocks stratified by urban/intermediate/rural typology); external test set also drawn with random and block selection. Six ML models; GSV images 2016-2022.

response_variable: Crop/land-cover type (rice, maize, buildings, water, forest, other)
predictor_sources: MODIS optical time series; Sentinel-1 SAR time series; phenological and structural prior features
data_quality_controls: labels from visual interpretation of Sentinel-2/Google Earth with 2024 field checks and farmer interviews; only plots with stable land use; normalisation fitted on training folds only
notes: Donggang City, Liaoning (~2399 km2), 2019. Spatial: 5-fold block CV with 0.02 x 0.02 deg (~2 km) blocks chosen to balance samples vs separation. Random comparison (RCV) described as sample-based 7:3 randomized partition; whether RCV in Table 6 used folds is not stated. Classes: 255/227/123/59/327/180. Models: CNN variants, XGBoost.

response_variable: Live fuel moisture of chamise chaparral (%)
predictor_sources: MODIS MCD43A4 and VIIRS VNP43 NBAR reflectance/indices; PRISM climate; phenology (analog-year, survival-based dry-down)
data_quality_controls: Globe-LFMC 2.0 QC and outlier flags (isolated outliers excluded); new/old growth averaged per site-date; site coordinates relocated (<=3 km) to homogeneous chaparral or site excluded (49 relocated, 13 unchanged, 26 excluded); QA=255 pixels excluded; 16-day min-red compositing; MODIS-VIIRS spectral harmonisation
notes: Southern California chaparral, Globe-LFMC 2003-2022 plus Santa Barbara County FD data. RF random estimate = OOB (R2 0.74; full-data fit 0.92); spatial = leave-one-county-out (RF R2 0.51; MLR 0.63 vs 0.58). Number of counties and observations not given in main text. Independent temporal test with FEMS 2023-2024.

response_variable: Impervious vs pervious surface (binary) from Dynamic World built probability >0.5
predictor_sources: AlphaEarth 64-D foundation-model embeddings; Sentinel-2 bands and indices (baselines)
data_quality_controls: cloud-cover screening (<20%) for single-date baseline; reference labels acknowledged as model-derived (Dynamic World), not field-verified; GHSL cross-dataset consistency check
notes: Five megacities (Bangkok, Jakarta, Manila, Kuala Lumpur, Ho Chi Minh City), 60 x 60 km window each (5 x 3,600 km2). Robustness test: 2500 stratified-random labelled pixels per city; 20 repeated stratified 70/30 random hold-outs vs 20 spatial-block hold-outs (~0.05 deg, ~5 km). Also leave-one-city-out transferability. Response labels from Dynamic World (shared Sentinel-2 lineage). ISA 2017-2024.

response_variable: Cumulative flood intensity (count of flooded 1-ha cells per H3 hexagon) from Sentinel-1 SAR
predictor_sources: 5 m DEM (elevation, slope, TWI); latitude/longitude
data_quality_controls: SAR thermal-noise removal, radiometric calibration, terrain correction; Otsu threshold validated against GISTDA ground observations; standardisation fitted on training set only; no missing values
notes: Upper Chi River basin, Maha Sarakham Province; 541 H3 level-7 hexagons of ~5.96 km2 (implies ~3,224 km2, not stated). Flood years 2017, 2018, 2021, 2022. Stratified 80/20 train/test (432/109) plus standard 5-fold CV (R2 0.707) vs spatial 5-fold block CV (R2 0.583) for RF.

response_variable: National average annual temperature
predictor_sources: FAOSTAT national bioenergy production and consumption (bagasse, charcoal, fuelwood, vegetal residues, solid biofuels)
data_quality_controls: missing values multiply imputed with Amelia (EM with bootstrapping)
notes: African countries (not listed; 1188 country-year obs 2000-2021, implying 54 countries) - country_iso3 left NA. Data from FAOSTAT at national resolution. 10-fold random CV vs 10-block spatial CV; RF and XGBoost; spatial CV gave near-identical metrics. How blocks were built from country data not described.

response_variable: Heartwood rot occurrence, rot severity, rot volume and timber volume per 250-m2 grid cell / stand
predictor_sources: multi-temporal ALS metrics; Sentinel-2 and PlanetScope Dove vegetation indices; depth-to-water; ALS-derived terrain; forest management plan site index and age
data_quality_controls: harvester GNSS positions (~1 m); cells <100 m2 or spruce <70% removed; stands with <0.2 ha of cells discarded; Cook's-distance outlier removal (Hdom vs ALS H90) on training grid data, tested with and without
notes: Harvester ground reference from 46 operations (131,375 trees), Aug 2019-Nov 2021, SE Norway. 3715 grid cells and 109 stands (n_sites = stands). Random 10-fold CV vs 10-fold k-means spatial clustering CV; mean distance between folds 13.0 km (grid) and 11.4 km (stand). 32 grid and 16 stand RF models; grid-to-stand approach too.

response_variable: Grassland aboveground biomass (t/ha) from clipped quadrats
predictor_sources: Google satellite embedding (64-D annual); Sentinel-1; Sentinel-2; DEM-derived terrain
data_quality_controls: three 1x1 m quadrats per 0.5-ha plot, oven-dried to constant weight, averaged; impurities removed; predictors averaged in 40 m plot buffers
notes: Three Parallel Rivers region, NW Yunnan (8 counties; area not stated), field survey Jul-Sep 2022. Random 5-fold CV (XGBoost R2 0.795) vs 5-fold GroupKFold over 10 k-means groups built on standardised lon/lat/elevation (R2 0.766). Plots placed purposively for representativeness.

response_variable: Xylella fastidiosa presence/absence per 500-m grid cell from official PCR surveillance
predictor_sources: Meteo-France SICLIMA climate and bioclim indices; RMQS soil chemistry; Corine Land Cover 2018; Copernicus/SRTM DEM
data_quality_controls: ~59,000 lab-confirmed samples aggregated to 500 m grid to reduce clustered sampling effort; unsampled cells excluded; missing predictors imputed (nearest neighbour + administrative constraints); correlation filtering in feature selection
notes: Southern France 2015-2023; 913 infected vs 9714 non-infected cells. Random: stratified (region x status) 80/20 split repeated 50 times vs leave-one-region-out repeated 30 times (main scenario train Corsica+PACA, test Occitania); also LORO + alpha local data. Tuning used 4-fold environmental block CV. RF, XGB, spatially weighted variants, Bayesian spatial logistic benchmark.

response_variable: Forest canopy height (airborne LiDAR CHM)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2; airborne LiDAR structural metrics (canopy cover, understory density, height SD)
data_quality_controls: Sentinel-2 scenes <20% cloud plus SCL cloud/shadow masking; median composite; patches with <80% forest discarded; CHM limited to 2-40 m; negative CHM removed
notes: n_observations = image patches (256x256 px); spatial split is single train/test split of 5 km x 5 km blocks (876 train / 100 test patches, ~90/10); U-Net and SwinUNet; independent 2023 backpack LiDAR plots (n=97); temporal span 2020-2023

response_variable: Parasitic isopod (Portunion conformis) abundance per crab, pond-level
predictor_sources: In situ water quality (pH, temperature, salinity, DO, transparency, COD, H2S)
data_quality_controls: Three replicate water measurements averaged; screened for missing values and outliers (none removed); z-score standardization within folds
notes: Study area = Ca Mau province (~5300 km2); random scheme compared with LOPO is random 5-fold CV; a 75/25 random split was also used for main model fit; grouped 5-fold by pond also reported; unit = pond (fish pond, not an administrative unit; closest category); XGBoost, RF, SVM, GLM, GAM

response_variable: Wildfire occurrence (fire / no fire, NASA FIRMS)
predictor_sources: WeatherAPI reanalysis weather; FWI indices (FFMC, DMC, DC, ISI, BUI, FWI); date variables
data_quality_controls: FIRMS records filtered (high confidence and FRP>5); non-fire dates without FIRMS detections; oversampling only on training folds; preprocessing and cleaning
notes: Al-Soudah region, Asir; Saudi dataset 73 fire/540 non-fire (11.9% fire); spatial CV = five geographically separated groups defined from latitude/longitude (method not specified); Algerian dataset (244 records) used only in random CV experiments; FIRMS 2019-2025

response_variable: Soil organic matter (0-20 cm)
predictor_sources: SRTM DEM terrain; climate (MAT, MAP, LST); vegetation index; soil properties (N, pH); geographic location
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: Anhui Province (sub-national, 140,100 km2 > 100,000 km2 threshold); blocks defined by longitude/latitude; random 5-fold CV used only for tuning; samples collected 2010; 2024 map is unvalidated projection; RF, GB, Extra Trees, LightGBM

response_variable: Land use land cover class (7 classes)
predictor_sources: LISS IV bands; spectral indices; Sentinel-2 (comparison)
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: Northern Bengaluru; field ground-truth points Dec 2020-Jan 2021, LISS IV image Feb 2021; variogram range 568 m, hexagonal blocks 1500 m via blockCV, grouped into 7 folds balanced by class; RF, XGB, LGB; AOA used for unseen areas (no labels)

response_variable: Aboveground biomass stock and change (UAV-LiDAR/yield-table derived, 10 m)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-1; Sentinel-2; DEM (AW3D30)
data_quality_controls: Sentinel-2 scenes <10% cloud; Sentinel-1 terrain correction and speckle filtering; Baskerville bias correction; individual-tree QC against yield tables and forest register
notes: Training in 4 UAV-LiDAR survey areas (Miyoshi City), mapping Shikoku Island; random 10% hold-out also used for tuning; block size ~100 m matched variogram range; leave-one-survey-area-out (k=4) also reported (R2 0.41); n_observations = stock-model pixels (17,560 for change models); random 10-fold CV robustness check also reported

response_variable: Coffee production system and land cover class (10 classes)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2; Landsat 8/9; Sentinel-1; SRTM DEM
data_quality_controls: Cloud/shadow masking (QA60, SCL, QA_PIXEL); labels retained only when three interpreters agreed; field checks Nov-Dec 2025; leakage-removed sensitivity analysis
notes: Dak Lak province; 300 points per class by visual interpretation of VHR imagery; stratified 5-fold random CV (OA 95.9%) and stratified 70/30 fixed split; spatial blocks of 10, 15 and 20 km, 5 folds; mapping year 2024; RF in GEE

response_variable: Aquatic vegetation class (SAV vs EAV)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2; Sentinel-1; spectral and SAR indices
data_quality_controls: Cloud-aware median compositing (+/-90 days); reference map from 0.305 m aerial imagery with expert refinement
notes: Everglades STAs, South Florida; labels sampled from SFWMD polygon vegetation map; text says 6731 samples per class but Table 2 lists 6731 samples in training area (51.2% SAV); spatial evaluation = two geographically separated unseen areas (7.78 and 27.22 km2) with models retrained on all samples, i.e. spatial evaluation and independent test are the same data; training area 85.77 km2; composite centred May 2016; RF and TabNet

response_variable: CO2 emission flux density (ODIAC target)
predictor_sources: GOSAT XCO2; NO2; VIIRS nighttime lights; OSM roads; impervious surface; NDVI; population; socioeconomic statistics
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: Guilin; 5x5 lat/lon grid (25 blocks, leave-one-block-out) and buffered block CV (adjacent blocks excluded); random 8:1:1 split used during development; target is ODIAC 1 km product downscaled to 10 m; 2019-2024; CatBoost, RF, MLP; EDGAR comparison only

response_variable: Column-averaged methane XCH4 (TROPOMI)
predictor_sources: ERA5 meteorology; MODIS reflectance and NDVI; MCD12Q1 land cover; LandScan population; MERIT DEM; temporal variables
data_quality_controls: TROPOMI QA>0.5 filtering; MODIS cloud masking; comparison with Hefei TCCON for retrieval accuracy
notes: Inner Mongolia (sub-national, >100,000 km2); 0.1 deg grid; 1x1 deg blocks with GroupKFold (number of folds not reported); independent test set is random hold-out (ratio not reported); 2019-2023; stacked ensemble (RF, XGBoost, LightGBM, SVR, MLP, KNN); CAMS comparison

response_variable: Presence of scorpion Androctonus mauritanicus
predictor_sources: WorldClim bioclim; wind speed; relative humidity; soil moisture; land surface temperature; urban fraction; DEM terrain
data_quality_controls: Duplicate and erroneous records removed; spatial thinning 5 km; VIF<5 predictor screening
notes: Field surveys June 2024-June 2025 plus GBIF; 10,000 background points; MaxEnt with ENMeval; random = 5 MaxEnt cross-validation replicates (AUC 0.923), spatial block CV validation AUC 0.828; spatial_k reported as five-fold in text

response_variable: Rockfall occurrence per road evaluation unit
predictor_sources: DEM terrain; lithology; faults; NDVI; land use (CLCD); rainfall; slope-cutting height (Hcut); UAV photogrammetry
data_quality_controls: Inventory from field survey and UAV checks; VIF screening; label-buffer sensitivity (50/100/150 m) and exclusion of ambiguous negatives within 250 m
notes: Wufeng County, Hubei; 159 rockfall / 391 non-rockfall REUs (road line segments); spatial = leave-one-road-corridor-out (highway trunks such as G351, G241, S476) giving ~70/30 spatial holdout; 'administrative_unit' used as closest unit for road corridor; 13 algorithms; external test in adjacent county (AUC 0.7246)

response_variable: Composite geohazard occurrence (landslide, rockfall, debris flow) per slope unit
predictor_sources: ALOS PALSAR DEM terrain; lithology; faults; OSM rivers and roads; rainfall; Landsat NDVI; CNLUCC land use
data_quality_controls: Collinearity screening (VIF>10 removed); negative-sample exclusion buffer sensitivity (200-1500 m); hazard data supplemented with field verification
notes: Tongren City, Qinghai; 189 positive + 189 negative slope units from 18,136; 5x5 quantile grid groups, StratifiedGroupKFold 5 folds repeated 5 times with 5000 m training exclusion buffer; grid (4x4-6x6) and buffer (3000-7000 m) sensitivity; 92 independent verification points used as overlay test; RF, CatBoost, TabPFN

response_variable: Seismic susceptibility class (within 10 km of historical M>=4 epicentres)
predictor_sources: SRTM DEM terrain; MODIS NDVI; GlobeLand30 land cover; TWI; GEM active faults; HWSD soil
data_quality_controls: Water/no-data masking; pixels with missing values excluded; NDVI aggregated to reduce cloud contamination; 10-20 km boundary zone excluded from sampling; collinearity diagnostic
notes: Labels from USGS earthquake catalogue 1970-2024; ~20,000 balanced samples from ~2.7 million 500 m pixels; 576 blocks (24x24 tiles) assigned to 5 folds checkerboard-style; block size in km not reported; GBDT, XGBoost, RF, LightGBM, LR

response_variable: Mean summer land surface temperature (Landsat LST)
predictor_sources: Green-space patch metrics; Baidu Street View green view index; 3D green volume; canopy height
data_quality_controls: Cloud and cloud-shadow pixels masked; one invalid record removed; road-network topology checks and duplicate-line removal
notes: Central Wuhan (within Third Ring Road); 150 m radius street units at 50 m spacing; buffered spatial CV: 1 km x 1 km blocks, training units within 300 m of test excluded; June-August 2022; LR and RF

response_variable: River ice spectral subclass (4 classes)
predictor_sources: Landsat 5/7; Landsat 8/9; Sentinel-2 surface reflectance bands
data_quality_controls: Images <20% cloud and visually checked cloud-free; NDSI/RDRI river ice extraction; pseudo-labels from K-means checked by stratified visual interpretation and ANOVA
notes: Tibetan Plateau, eight basins (leave-one-basin-out, BPNN); 356 winter scenes 2000-2024; random split ratio not reported; basin is a hydrological unit (closest category administrative_unit); labels are cluster-derived pseudo-labels

response_variable: Tamarix chinensis presence (binary)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2; Sentinel-1; red-edge and vegetation cover features; seasonal phenology
data_quality_controls: Sentinel-2 scenes <5% cloud, median composite; labels from UAV orthophotos and GPS by visual interpretation
notes: Yellow River Delta National Nature Reserve; 616 train / 155 test (106 tamarisk, 49 other in test); 5-fold CV on training set for threshold (F1 0.858); spatial block CV AUC 0.770 vs hold-out AUC 0.804; summer 2025; XGBoost

response_variable: Flood occurrence (flooded / non-flooded)
predictor_sources: USGS DEM terrain; distance to drainage; ESRI land cover; NASA POWER precipitation
data_quality_controls: Three duplicates removed; missing-value and duplicate checks; points verified on Landsat imagery and cross-checked with local specialists; correlation screening
notes: M'sila city; 150 flooded / 140 non-flooded points from Landsat imagery, historical records and reports; spatial CV = three geographically distinct zones; Moran's I = 0.766; separate reference points from 6 areas (100 m buffer from training) for AUC of AHP/ML maps; RF, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost

response_variable: Presence of four Korthalsia rattan species
predictor_sources: TerraClimate climate (VPD, light, evapotranspiration); ISRIC SoilGrids soil properties; elevation
data_quality_controls: Fossil and pre-1800 records removed; coordinate and extent checks; one record per 1 km grid cell; herbarium verification; pseudo-absences 10:1 with 1 km buffer; VIF<5
notes: Tropical Southeast Asia calibration region (Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Sumatra, Java, Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, Laos); occurrences from GBIF, literature, field observations (K. scortechinii n=12, K. flagellaris n=26); random = subsampling/bootstrap with 30% test; post hoc blockCV spatial CV for RF only

response_variable: Groundwater nitrate exceedance (NO3 > 50 mg/L)
predictor_sources: climate (PET); hydrogeology; land cover; DEM/terrain; soil; population density
data_quality_controls: missing predictors imputed by neighbourhood median; outlier screening and extreme-value adjustment; SMOTE on training folds only
notes: Handan City shallow groundwater 2023; 31/157 exceedances (19.7%); 300 repeated stratified 80:20 hold-outs with inner stratified 5-fold tuning; spatial block CV 15x15 km grid groups allocated to 5 folds; RF/SVM/XGBoost

response_variable: Landslide occurrence (presence/absence)
predictor_sources: ALOS PALSAR DEM; Sentinel-2; IMD rainfall; Bhukosh geology/lithology; roads
data_quality_controls: duplicate landslide records removed; field/GPS validation of inventory; multicollinearity, Spearman and Boruta feature selection
notes: Raigad district (Western Ghats); 178 landslides (Bhukosh, NASA catalog, field survey) + 178 non-landslide points; spatial 5-fold CV with 50 km buffer distance (fold construction not detailed); also reports Test AUC; six ML models

response_variable: Nanorana parkeri presence vs target-group background
predictor_sources: WorldClim/CMIP6 climate; terrain; hydrological accessibility
data_quality_controls: duplicates within 1 km removed; georeference/geospatial issue screening; spatial thinning 10 km; target-group background bias correction; VIF screening
