predictor_sources: daily weather (China Meteorological Data Service) whole-season and stage-specific; cultivar BLUP; field-survey agronomic traits; sowing season
data_quality_controls: records with missing yield removed; cultivar labels standardised (205 to 168); preprocessing and BLUP fitted within training partitions (leakage control)
notes: National rice variety trials, 10 sites in Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan and Fujian, 2016-2022, 67 site-years; leave-one-site-out (10), leave-one-year-out, forward-year (6 splits) and leave-one-site-year-out; Ridge, ElasticNet, RF, XGBoost, LightGBM

response_variable: Forest soil organic carbon density (0-20 cm and 0-100 cm)
predictor_sources: climate; vegetation; soil; topography (Table 1)
data_quality_controls: data screening of SOC observations; collinear predictors removed
notes: China Terrestrial Ecosystem Carbon Density Dataset (2010s), forest subset: 1664 samples (0-20 cm), 1248 (0-100 cm); random 80/20 split with 5-fold CV on training set; spatial 5-fold CV with 243 1x1 deg blocks (~6-7 samples each); RF, DT, XGBoost; n_sites = blocks

response_variable: Quinoa aboveground biomass volume (m3/100 m2) at 10 m from UAV photogrammetry
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 bands and indices; Sentinel-1 VV/VH backscatter, polarization and GLCM texture indices
data_quality_controls: photogrammetric products visually checked to exclude distorted areas; S2 cloud masking (QA60); S1 noise removal, calibration, terrain correction and speckle filter; post-harvest images excluded
notes: Central Altiplano, La Paz; 5 quinoa plots (0.36-1.89 ha) flown Apr-May 2025; UAV CHM + CNN masks give reference ABV at 10 m; 10-fold random CV vs leave-one-plot-out CV; RF, GB, XGB, stacking, CNN

response_variable: Seasonal-median MODIS daytime LST (deg C) at 1 km, summer 2025
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 bands and indices; SRTM DEM terrain derivatives; ESA WorldCover sub-pixel fractions
data_quality_controls: MODIS MOD11A1 good-quality QC flags only; Sentinel-2 and Landsat cloud/shadow masking; seasonal (Jun-Sep) medians; standardisation fitted within training folds
notes: Greater Cairo; coarse-scale regression on 3340 1 km cells; random 5-fold vs spatial blocks of 3, 5 and 8 km (also buffered blocks); independent comparison with Landsat 8/9 LST at 100 m (not a spatial hold-out); seven algorithms

response_variable: Standing herbaceous biomass (kg/ha, plot scale)
predictor_sources: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 (HLS v2.0) bands, 16 vegetation indices, 6 band-angle indices
data_quality_controls: additional cloud/shadow masking; pixel-scale smoothing and gap-filling to daily; visual obstruction readings averaged per transect and plot
notes: Central Plains Experimental Range, Colorado; 132 plots in 29 pastures, 2013-2023; random 10-fold by plot vs leave-one-group-out on 5 spatial blocks of pastures, 3 ecosites, 10 years and 5 spectral k-means clusters; OLS, PLS, PCR, SVR, RF, HGBR

response_variable: Lake dissolved organic carbon (mg C/L)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 MSI reflectance; ERA5-Land (hydroclimate, LAI, wind); geographic coordinates
data_quality_controls: only DOC samples from <=1 m depth; same location-date samples averaged; +/-7 day match-up; scenes >30% cloud discarded; 3x3 window used only if all pixels water (SCL=6)
notes: SITES and SLU MVM repositories, 349 lakes, 2017-2024; random 75/25 hold-out (10-fold CV for tuning) vs spatial block CV (details in Supplementary Note S2); XGBoost, RF, SVR, GPR, MLP; coordinate-only and IDW baselines

response_variable: Summer land surface temperature (MODIS MOD11A2, deg C) on 1 km grid
predictor_sources: MODIS MOD09A1 indices (NDVI, NDWI, NDBI); land use; landscape metrics; DEM; nighttime lights; population density; GDP
data_quality_controls: 8-day MODIS composites averaged over Jun-Aug (no missing pixels); all layers aligned to 1 km grid; variables standardised
notes: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area; ~52,000 1 km cells x 5 epochs (2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020); random stratified CV (k not reported) vs 5x5 spatial block CV (25 blocks); forward temporal validation 2000-2015 -> 2020; XGBoost, RF, LightGBM, linear, ridge

response_variable: Suspended sediment indicators (suspended solids, turbidity) in estuarine water column
predictor_sources: co-sampled BOD (5-day ATU); water temperature (regulatory monitoring archive)
data_quality_controls: exact duplicate records removed; non-numeric and censored values excluded; stations with <60 sediment observations excluded; temporal pairing tolerance windows (0/3/7 d); rows with missing predictors excluded; no gap-filling or interpolation
notes: River Mersey estuary regulatory monitoring 2015-2025 (44,516 obs, 42 stations) reduced to 528 paired station-time events at 6 stations; RF; 70/30 random split (test R2 0.588) and random 5-fold CV also reported; GroupKFold by station (mean R2 0.258); number of grouped folds not reported

response_variable: Plant species identity of individual crowns (18 species)
predictor_sources: UAV RGB and multispectral (MicaSense RedEdge-P) imagery; SfM canopy height model; crown geometry
data_quality_controls: crowns from species with >9 individuals and height >=25 cm only; RTK GPS (+/-2 cm) field geolocation of labels; flights at fixed hours under clear/uniform sky; covariates standardised
notes: Sagebrush steppe, southern Idaho and SE Oregon; 14 sites (~2 ha UAV footprint each) 2022-2023; 10,234 labelled crowns filtered to 8,362; stacked ensemble (SVM, RF, GBC); 75/25 split stratified by species vs leave-one-site-out (F1 <0.09 to >0.90); natural class imbalance kept; bootstrap CIs (1000)

response_variable: County-level summer maize statistical yield (t/ha)
predictor_sources: CAMM crop model outputs with LAI assimilation; MODIS NDVI/EVI; GOSIF SIF; CLDAS meteorology; SPEI; agricultural machinery and sown-area statistics
data_quality_controls: counties with <10 maize pixels excluded; 616 city-level gap-filled records flagged and kept out of all test sets; preprocessing pipeline fitted on training data only
notes: Huang-Huai-Hai Plain (7 provinces/municipalities; area not reported); 3,434 county-year records plus 616 city-level supplements, 2011-2020; random CV = single 75/25 random split; leave-counties-out = 75% of counties train / 25% test; leave-years-out (train 2011-2018, test 2019-2020); RF, XGBoost and others

response_variable: Log relative diameter growth rate of individual trees per growth period
predictor_sources: ICP Forests Level II plot data (atmospheric deposition, soil solution chemistry, topography); crown defoliation assessments; long-term climate; stand age and density
data_quality_controls: outlier values removed using domain knowledge; growth periods <4 or >6 years excluded; dead trees (100% defoliation) excluded; for linear baseline features >50% missing dropped and median imputation within folds
notes: ICP Forests Level II network (multi-country Europe; countries not listed), 1993-2016; 18,353 trees of 4 species, 33,450 growth periods (sum of species); LightGBM per species; baseline 5-fold CV grouped by tree ID (with/without temporal blocking) vs 5-fold grouped by plot ID; data_source = intensive forest monitoring plots; plot count in final data not reported (up to 494 plots)

response_variable: 18S rRNA Shannon diversity index of surface microbial eukaryotic plankton
predictor_sources: CMEMS ocean-colour NPP; Mediterranean biogeochemical and physical reanalyses (nitrate, phosphate, DIC, temperature, salinity); euphotic depth; photoperiod; N:P ratio
data_quality_controls: samples without complete predictors removed (469 of 474); predictors averaged over 3x3-pixel window; inverse-frequency case weights by dataset
notes: Mediterranean Sea: fixed stations BBMO, SOLA (NW Med), VIDA (N Adriatic) and HOTMIX open-sea transect, 2001-2025; XGBoost; random = 84/16 hold-out stratified by dataset with 4-fold x3 repeated CV for tuning (test R2 0.44); spatial = leave-one-dataset-out (R2 0.09); blocked spatiotemporal LODO with forward-chaining tuning also run; country list from station locations, HOTMIX in international waters

response_variable: DSM minus DTM residual height (bare-earth terrain reconstruction)
predictor_sources: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 DSM; CSF priors; DSM-derived slope, aspect, curvature and local relief
data_quality_controls: vertical datum harmonisation (NAVD88 to EGM2008); NoData excluded without inpainting; tiles with <95% valid pixels removed
notes: Reference DTM = USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second; 7 development states (MO, TN, OK, GA, KY, AL, IL) split randomly 70/15/15 (train/val/test) vs Arkansas held out entirely as out-of-region test; area = sum of 8 state areas in Table 1; residual U-Net (deep learning); 512x512 tiles at 30 m

response_variable: Surface soil moisture (vol.%, 0-7 cm) under cotton
predictor_sources: Sentinel-1 VV/VH backscatter; Sentinel-2 NDVI; radar vegetation index
data_quality_controls: TDR calibrated against gravimetric method; >=4 readings averaged per 30x30 m grid; sampling grids >=30 m apart; Sentinel-2 cloud/shadow masking (QA60); SAR speckle filter, terrain correction and incidence-angle normalisation
notes: Two cotton fields (UAF, PARS) ~8 km apart, Faisalabad, LCC command area; 9 visits Jul-Nov 2018; RF, SVM and water cloud model; random = 50:50 stratified by site (68/67); spatial = train UAF (81) / validate PARS (54)

response_variable: Landslide occurrence (landslide vs non-landslide)
predictor_sources: DEM-derived elevation, slope, aspect, HAND; geomorphological units; lithological units (1:25,000)
data_quality_controls: inventory from stereo aerial photo and orthophoto/IKONOS interpretation validated by fieldwork; non-landslide points restricted to low-susceptibility areas excluding known unstable sites; 50 m buffer from landslides for resampled non-landslides; Gain Ratio feature ranking
notes: Ouro Preto, Quadrilatero Ferrifero (Minas Gerais); 304 landslides + 304 non-landslides (1:1); nine ML methods; 100 x stratified 10-fold random CV vs spatial CV with 10 k-means geographic clusters; temporal span of inventory not reported

response_variable: Daily ground-level NO2 concentration (ug/m3)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI or GEOS-CF tropospheric NO2 VCD; meteorology; SRTM DEM; MODIS NDVI; VIIRS night lights; OSM road length; population density; day of year
data_quality_controls: NO2 records outside 1-300 ug/m3 or missing removed (2.5%); stations lacking data in all periods excluded; S5P pixels with cloud fraction >=0.3 excluded; VIF and correlation-based feature removal
notes: Marmara Region 2019-2024, 74 MoEUCC stations; RF, XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM; random 70/10/20 train/val/test vs temporal split (2019-2022 train, 2023 val, 2024 test); spatial LOSO (74 folds) and leave-one-province-out (11 folds); n_observations = retained records after QC

response_variable: Age-specific abundance of sprat and herring per ICES statistical rectangle
predictor_sources: year; ICES subdivision; age cohort; rectangle area; rectangle coordinates; mean annual abundance (no environmental covariates)
data_quality_controls: standardised ICES/WGBIFS hydroacoustic survey protocol (>=60 nm transect per 1000 nm2, >=2 trawl hauls per rectangle)
notes: Baltic Sea acoustic surveys BASS and BIAS 2002-2022 (up to eight countries); LMM, GAM, XGBoost and baseline imputation; random = for each year x subdivision a random p% (10-99%) of rectangles held out as test, 10 iterations; spatial = all rectangles south of 57.5 N removed for a given year (contiguous-area extrapolation); n of rectangle records not reported

response_variable: Cereal leaf beetle damage status of 1x1 m quadrats (damaged, control, wheel track)
predictor_sources: UAV RGB vegetation indices (VARI, GCC, GLI, NGRDI) and their deviations from field median/mean
data_quality_controls: quadrats with weeds or patchy vegetation excluded; specimens identified to species; flights under <15% cloud cover; radiometric rectification per band; class weights for imbalance
notes: Five winter cereal fields in Lorinci and Bolcske (2024), 30 sample plots of 10x10 m split into 1x1 m quadrats, three UAV surveys; RF and LightGBM; random 30% test vs geospatially controlled test (whole fields in Bolcske, field sections in Lorinci); tuning by 5-fold CV grouped by sampling location

response_variable: Future seasonal Landsat NDVI (deviation from last same-season observation)
predictor_sources: Landsat 5/7/8/9 seasonal NDVI composite time series (1990-2024)
data_quality_controls: scenes >70% cloud excluded; QA_PIXEL cloud, cirrus and shadow masking; 90-day median compositing; cross-sensor calibration; tile cleaning (250,000 to 200,000 tiles)
notes: GloSeaN dataset; SeasonalViT transformer vs 8 baselines; 100 k-means blocks on lat/lon allocated to Pool A (177,523 locations, train + in-distribution val_id of held-out Pool A locations) and Pool B (22,477 locations, spatial OOD); temporal OOD 2023-2024; random val_id percentages not reported

response_variable: Landslide presence/absence per slope unit after the 15 Sep 2022 extreme rainfall event
predictor_sources: 10 m DEM derivatives; lithology map; CORINE land cover 2018; regional soil map; rain-gauge rainfall anomaly and preparatory rainfall (IDW)
data_quality_controls: landslide mapping from VHR imagery validated and integrated with post-event field survey; spatial variable selection with spatial CV
notes: Misa River basin (Central Italy); 630 shallow landslides; 2,049 slope units; Explainable Boosting Machine; 10x repeated 10-fold random CV (100 folds) vs k-means 5-fold spatial CV on SU centroids repeated 10 times (50 folds); number of positive SUs not reported

response_variable: Grassland forage quality and quantity (metabolizable energy, aboveground biomass, ME yield)
predictor_sources: field hyperspectral reflectance (ASD FieldSpec, 450-2350 nm); first derivatives; absorption features; vegetation indices
data_quality_controls: white-reference calibration before each measurement; 5 replicate scans averaged; Savitzky-Golay smoothing; noisy and water-absorption bands removed; samples with <40% vegetation cover excluded
notes: Three regions (temperate Germany 2020-2021, West African savanna 2012, Namibian thornbush savanna 2021), seven study areas; 456 spectra (318 ME samples); RF, PLS and neural networks; global 5-fold CV vs leave-one-region-out (train two regions, test third); regional 80/20 train-test used for global-vs-regional comparison

response_variable: Pairwise dissimilarity in tree basal area increment (Picea mariana)
predictor_sources: CRU TS 4.07 climate (temperature, precipitation, cloud cover, PET, DTR); tree age; time and space distance
data_quality_controls: cores filtered by radius (5-100 cm) and ring width (<1 cm); only rings after 1950; Tukey biweight robust mean site chronologies
notes: International Tree-Ring Data Bank, Quebec; 733 cores at 28 sites, 1950-2022; RF temporal, spatial and integrated TS models on pairwise dissimilarities; internal validation by random 10-fold (90/10) CV vs external validation on 30% of sites held out; n_observations = ring-width measurements (pairwise sets 2,192-22,100)

response_variable: Late-summer surface flow presence (wet vs dry) in headwater streams
predictor_sources: LiDAR 5 m DEM hydro-topographic metrics; PRISM-type 800 m precipitation and temperature (2015-2021, 1980-2010 normals); land cover
data_quality_controls: only natural channels; discontinuous-flow points removed; geolocation error <=10 m (95% CEP); points within 10 m of NHD LiDAR hydrography; missing covariates removed; covariates with r >0.97 removed; spatial balancing with oversampling at HUC12 level
notes: Western Oregon forested lands; FLOwPER observations 2019-2021 (1,361 wet / 1,157 dry; oversampled to 1,538/1,538); RF (WET DRY model), also XGBoost; 20 spatially balanced groups; 20 x random 5-fold (proximal) vs 5-fold with HUC12 sub-watersheds held out (distal); accuracy 0.83 vs 0.67

response_variable: Lake chlorophyll-a concentration (also SD, TSS, aCDOM(440))
predictor_sources: in situ hyperspectral remote sensing reflectance 400-800 nm (GLORIA); simulated Landsat-8 and Sentinel-2 bands
data_quality_controls: wavelengths with >90% missing excluded; KNN imputation of 690-800 nm gaps (<5%); IQR outlier removal on water-quality variables
notes: GLORIA global lake dataset; RF, ETR, XGB, BGR and others; random 70/30 split vs spatial split holding out 30% of lakes (75 lakes, 626 obs) for CHL-a only (R2 0.675, ~12% lower); counts given for CHL-a

response_variable: Modified groundwater quality index (mWQI) of hazardous sites aggregated to census block groups
predictor_sources: EPA EJScreen socioeconomic, environmental and EJ indicators (118 features); census block-group attributes
data_quality_controls: sites without regulated CoCs, without detections or below MCL removed; duplicate measurements and spurious timestamps discarded; zero-population block groups removed; missing EJS data (<1%) filled; KNNOR-Reg oversampling for imbalanced regression; Pearson multicollinearity filter
notes: Coastal California GeoTracker groundwater monitoring 1995-2024; 2,296 hazardous sites aggregated to 837 block groups; neural networks tuned by multi-objective optimisation; 10-fold random CV vs 10 k-means spatial folds on block-group centroids

response_variable: Pasture biomass (kg DM/ha) from rising plate meter
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 surface reflectance bands; vegetation indices (NDVI, EVI, SAVI, NDRE); daily weather; paddock management
data_quality_controls: Fmask cloud/shadow masking; spectral outliers beyond 1.5 IQR removed; monthly rising plate meter calibration with cuts; complete-case filtering; validation PB limited to 1000-4000 kg DM/ha
notes: 80 paddocks on 16 NSW dairy farms, Nov 2021-Jul 2024; XGBoost and 7 other regressors; 80:20 farm/paddock-stratified random split (2,528/633) with 5-fold x3 repeated CV for tuning; leave-farm-out (train 15 farms, test 1; number of iterations unclear; R2 0.46 vs 0.63-0.70); independent hold-outs: Nov 2024 (n=41) and spatially separate sixth paddock (n=63)

response_variable: High Nature Value (HNV) farmland quality category (HNV I/II/III)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 bands; spectral diversity (Rao's Q, CV); NDVImax date; biogeographic region
data_quality_controls: parcels >=0.5 ha after 5 m negative buffer to remove edge effects; missing values excluded; partition balanced by class; Alps and Alpine foothills merged to balance spatial folds
notes: German HNV monitoring 2017-2021 (BfN); RF via CAST; data split 60% train / 40% test (balanced partition, groupdata2); random 10-fold CV vs leave-location-out by biogeographic regions (n=5) and leave-time-out by year; 100 iterations; fold unit is biogeographic region (not administrative)

response_variable: Potato tuber fresh yield (t/ha)
predictor_sources: soil lab analyses; SoilGrids; fertiliser and management; weather stations; EarthEnv-DEM90; WorldGrids terrain; MODIS EVI
data_quality_controls: replicate yield variability (measurement error) quantified; collinearity screened (Pearson r)
notes: 63 field experiments, 9 provinces, 2017-2019; 79 blocks grouped into 62 sites (blocks within 200 m = one site); RF; 10-fold CV vs leave-block-out, leave-site-out and leave-year-out CV; RMSE 3.5 vs 8.3/9.9/10.3 t/ha

response_variable: Nearshore water depth (bathymetry, m) from NOAA airborne LiDAR
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 L2A median composite and 49 images; PRISMA hyperspectral
data_quality_controls: cloud filter (<5% scene cloud); NIR/red threshold cloud, water and cloud-shadow masks; median compositing to reduce sunglint; LiDAR reference MAE 1.2 m acknowledged
notes: Southwest Puerto Rico; XGBoost, U-Net, 2D-3D CNN, band-ratio models; study area divided into 4 areas of similar pixel count, iteratively 3 train / 1 test; random train-test split (percentages not reported) gave 36.7% lower MAE for XGBoost; n_observations = Sentinel-2 composite pixels (PRISMA 908,583)

response_variable: Maize grain yield (kg/ha) and agronomic efficiency of N, P, K (kg/kg)
predictor_sources: soil properties (trial and Soil Research Institute gap-fill); GMet weather; topography; crop genotype; management; fertiliser rates
data_quality_controls: exploratory outlier detection (histograms, boxplots); gap-filling of missing soil (17-68%) and climate (80%) records; normalisation
notes: Georeferenced maize trials 1996-2021 across six agroecological zones; RF, SVM, KNN, XGBoost; LOOCV vs leave-site-out and leave-agroecological-zone-out CV; tuning by 10-fold CV repeated 5 times; AE subsets n=3106/2858/2760; number of sites not reported

response_variable: Subnational maize production and yield
predictor_sources: CHIRPS precipitation; NOAA CPC temperature; reference ET; NDVI; soil moisture; cropland mask; soil attributes; livelihood zones
data_quality_controls: crop statistics from FEWS NET Data Warehouse (quality-controlled); calibration and refinement to current administrative boundaries
notes: Burkina Faso 45 admin-2 districts 1985-2021 and Somalia 31 districts 1995-2020; XGBoost panel model; random K-fold (K = number of years) vs leave-district-out vs leave-year-out vs time-series CV; also random 80/20 split table; operational forecasts tested on last 5 years

response_variable: Snow water equivalent (SWE, mm) for bias correction of ERA5-Land
predictor_sources: ERA5-Land SWE; Copernicus DEM (elevation, slope, aspect); elevation difference; ecozone; day of year
data_quality_controls: Z-score >3 outliers removed (5.22%, 26,237 of 502,461 rows); daily automated data aggregated to biweekly; sites with <1 year of data excluded; Oct-May only
notes: CanSWE 1971-2021 plus US airborne gamma (NorSWE); RF; random 80/20 split with 5-fold CV on training data vs spatial transfer (sites randomly split into 5 groups 80/20, repeated 5 times) and leave-one-ecozone-out (15 ecozones); temporal transfer trained 1971-2014, tested 2015-2021

response_variable: Badland presence/absence (susceptibility)
predictor_sources: DEM-derived morphometrics; NDVI; lithology; climate; landslide susceptibility
data_quality_controls: inventory from aerial photo-interpretation verified and double-checked with field visits; 10 m minimum distance between badland polygons and non-badland points; Catalonia polygons filtered (>1 ha, slope >15 deg, soft lithology) and checked with orthophotos
notes: Upper Llobregat River Basin (505 km2), upscaling test to Catalonia (32,114 km2, 880 points); RF; 70/30 train/test then 10-fold CV vs spatial CV (spatially disjoint subregions, repeated 10 times; partition details in supplement) on small dataset (450+450 points); AUC 0.972 vs 0.959; large dataset 12,404 points also used; also separate 30% hold-out

response_variable: Citrus orchard abandonment status (non-productive, productive, abandoned)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 time series (OSAVI, NDMI) and annual statistics
data_quality_controls: Sentinel-2 scenes <75% cloud; SCL masking of no-data/saturated/cloud pixels; linear interpolation of gaps; Savitzky-Golay smoothing; labels verified with orthophotos and Street View
notes: La Safor (43,000 ha), Comunitat Valenciana; RF; datasets OLV-19 (240), LSF-20 (280, UAV cluster sample), LSF-21 (836); random 4-fold CV with balanced classes vs spatial 4-fold k-means on XY; OA difference up to 3%; external tests on 4 other areas (80 parcels each) and other years; OLV-19 balanced, LSF sets imbalanced

response_variable: Hourly surface air temperature (K)
predictor_sources: FY-4A LST; MODIS vegetation indices; ERA5 reanalysis; GMTED2010 DEM; time and location variables
data_quality_controls: ISD station data with 54-step uniform QC; LST gaps from cloud contamination not filled
notes: FY-4A full-disc land area (55E-255E, 45S-55N: South, East, Central Asia, Pacific islands, Australia); Aug 2019-Jul 2020; RF baseline and spatial/temporal/spatiotemporal variants; sample-based 10-fold CV RMSE 1.65-2.08 K vs site-based 10-fold CV 2.22-2.70 K; number of samples not reported

response_variable: Pinus radiata canopy cover (%)
predictor_sources: UAV RGB orthomosaics (CNN regression: ResNet50, InceptionV3, Xception)
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: Five UAV sites in coastal range of Maule region, March 2016; per-site sample sizes 667-3264; multi-site models used 2000 observations (500 per site) split 60/20/20 train/validation/test at random, with the fifth site held out for transfer (5 iterations, like spatial block k-fold)

response_variable: Longfin and Shortfin eel presence/absence (probability of capture)
predictor_sources: River Environment Classification (environmental, hydrological, spatial descriptors from DEM); organisation as catchability proxy
data_quality_controls: duplicate records for same day and location removed; only electric fishing records; organisations with >=100 entries; NZFFD administrator review; VIF screening (VIF<5) of 86 covariates
notes: NZ Freshwater Fish Database 1974-2014; regularised RF (RRF) vs VAST vs GRaF; random K-fold vs spatial K-fold (k-means on coordinates, 100 balancing steps) with K=5, and K=50 for RRF and VAST; presence 55.3% Longfin, 22.1% Shortfin

response_variable: Gap-filled daily remote sensing products (MODIS LST, MAIAC AOD, OMI/TROPOMI NO2 and O3)
predictor_sources: ERA5-Land and CAMS reanalyses; land cover; DEM; other spatiotemporal covariates
data_quality_controls: MODIS LST pixels with error >3 K removed; AOD best-quality/adjacent-cloud flags only; station-day completeness thresholds (>=70% hourly coverage); manual vs automatic station prioritisation
notes: Catalonia 2018-2020; annual RF gap-filling models for 10 products (30 models); OOB validation vs spatially structured split (blocks sized to median gap area, 30% of blocks per day as test, 70% train); RMSE more than doubled; exposure models (QRF) validated separately by nested 10-fold leave-station-out CV

response_variable: Forest above-ground biomass (Mg/ha)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 bands; vegetation indices; GLCM texture
data_quality_controls: QA60 cloud masking; NDVI maximum compositing; VSURF feature selection; dataset cleaning for missing values and outliers mentioned
notes: East Jilin (126,000 km2; NFCI 2014 plots, n=1812) and central Guangxi (22,100 km2; 2017-2018 field plots, n=344); CatBoost, LightGBM, RF, XGBoost and hybrid; 80/20 train/validation split with random 5-fold vs spatial 5-fold CV (k-means clusters of coordinates; description of the two schemes is partly inverted in the text); combined area exceeds 100,000 km2 but sub-national

response_variable: Seabed backscatter, sediment mobilization frequency, mean current velocity (each in turn)
predictor_sources: multibeam bathymetry; backscatter; sediment mobilization frequency; FVCOM current velocity; X/Y coordinates
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: Bay of Fundy; simulation with n = 100-500 points, 20-80% random and the rest in 5 circular clusters (radius 2-10 km), 100 designs per combination; RF bagging; OOB vs spatial (buffered) LOO with buffer = spherical variogram range of OOB residuals (capped at hmax/4) vs covariance weighting; true accuracy from full raster

response_variable: Grassland plant species richness per 100 m2
predictor_sources: CHELSA climate; elevation; soil organic carbon; MODIS NPP/FPAR and phenology; habitat heterogeneity; functional-trait vegetation indices; spectral diversity
data_quality_controls: collinearity removal (VSURF ranking and VIF<10 backward stepwise)
notes: Mongolian Plateau (Mongolia and Inner Mongolia); sPlot plots (620) plus field surveys 2010-2012; RF; random 10-fold CV vs spatial CV (Ploton et al. 2020): Moran's I correlogram thresholds, hierarchical clustering into folds (3 folds for all variables, 1660 km; 6-57 folds for other predictor groups); R2 0.65 random vs 0.31-0.52 spatial

response_variable: Tree species class (pure, mixed and sparse classes)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 phenology time series (2017-2021) and metrics; DTM; NDSM from aerial stereo imagery
data_quality_controls: training polygons >=3000 m2 with >=90% target class and disjoint from NFI plots; snow, cloud and shadow masking; threshold outlier filter; Savitzky-Golay smoothing; synthetic pixels for mixed/sparse classes; point-cloud outlier detection
notes: Austrian forest area; hybrid neural network; random training-data hold-out (99% accuracy) vs clustered spatial split hold-out (>=5% of pixels, split distances 125-5000 m, 10 seeds; 74%) vs buffered NFI probability-sample validation (~9000 plots, 55% OA); n = training pixels

response_variable: Pasture above-ground biomass and nitrogen concentration (%N) of bahiagrass
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 L2A bands and 10 vegetation indices
data_quality_controls: cloud-free pixels verified visually and with cirrus band, cloudy pixels discarded; plate meter readings calibrated monthly against clipped AGB
notes: Florida: BRU (20 plots, 2021, 120 rows) and NFREC (6 paddocks, 2019-2021, 140 AGB rows, 145 %N rows); PCR, PLSR, LASSO, RF, SVR, GBM; random 10-fold (AGB) / 5-fold (%N) shuffled nested CV vs leave-one-plot-out, leave-date-out, leave-year-out; AGB also trained at BRU and tested at NFREC

response_variable: Nearshore water depth (m) from airborne lidar bathymetry
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 bands 1-5 summer composite (2017-2021); neighbourhood information
data_quality_controls: depths >20 m removed; QA60 cloud masking; 10th-percentile composite to reduce glint and turbidity; lidar vertical accuracy 0.5 m
notes: Southern Corsica; multi-band, band-ratio, RF, DNN, CNN; random vs blocked 60/20/20 calibration/validation/test split; 1600 m grid cells (about twice depth semivariogram range), 107 blocks; 5 iterations per subsample size (100-100,000); test n = 85,975

response_variable: Crop presence/absence (suitability) and county corn yield
predictor_sources: climate (1 km); soil; irrigation (USDA Census); topography; Shannon diversity index; latitude/longitude
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: stressor R package (PyCaret interface), 14-18 ML models; CONUS crop presence 2008-2019 (30 m pixels) and county corn yield 2008-2018; random 10-fold CV vs SCV by k-means on scaled predictors (kmult=5, i.e. 50 sub-clusters merged into 10 folds) and on lat/lon; 20 CV runs shown for yield

response_variable: Crop type per field parcel (5 classes: arable grass, winter rapeseed, winter rye, winter wheat, silage maize)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 L2A bands; vegetation indices; texture (GLCM); field-level statistics
data_quality_controls: parcels kept only with cloud-free Sentinel-2 observations; NDVI filter 0.28-0.87 to retain vegetated observations
notes: Brandenburg 2018; reference from LPIS/CAP farmer declarations (9,388 parcels, 36,359 cloud-free parcel observations); random 80/10/10 train/test/validation split; spatial transfer by training in north and testing in south (and reverse) across 18 temporal/spatial test scenarios; RF, XGBoost, SGD, MLP, SVM, majority voting

response_variable: Daily ground-level PM2.5 concentration (ug/m3)
predictor_sources: MAIAC AOD; HMS smoke plumes; meteorology; land cover; elevation; EPA point emissions
data_quality_controls: days included only when all data sources available
notes: San Francisco Bay Area target area 12,096 km2 (14 monitors) plus buffer training area (34 EPA monitors in total); 327 days in 2017; random split vs site-based (leave-one-station-out) CV with 34 splits; random fold count not reported; two-stage LME+GWR statistical model and AutoGluon ensemble; also isolates spatial/temporal r2 (Simpson's paradox)

response_variable: Volumetric soil water content (cm3/cm3) after irrigation
predictor_sources: FDEM (raw and inverted); ERT (raw and inverted); GPR velocity/amplitude
data_quality_controls: ERT data filtered for negative or >10,000 ohm-m apparent resistivity and stacking errors >1%; FDEM drift checks at reference location; instrument calibration
notes: Haddam Meadows, Connecticut, 20 x 10 m irrigation plot, single experiment July 2019; 1000 random 60/40 (39/27) shuffled train/test splits; transferability tests train x=0-9.5 m / test x=9.5-20 m and reverse; MVR, SVR, RRF

response_variable: Tree taxon per canopy pixel (NIWO: subalpine fir, lodgepole pine, Engelmann spruce, limber pine)
predictor_sources: NEON AOP hyperspectral (PCA); lidar canopy height model; RGB (visual check)
data_quality_controls: duplicate trees removed; trees surveyed after image acquisition removed; trees without canopy pixels in CHM removed; annotation by Scholl/filtering/snapping crown methods
notes: NEON NIWO site (training) and RMNP site (11 km away, inter-site test), STEI unlabelled for pre-training; 268-544 labelled trees per site/annotation; random pixel split vs random tree split vs plot-divide split (60/20/20 train/val/test stated for plot solver; random pixel proportions not stated explicitly); 5 trials each; RF and (semi-)supervised deep learning; AOP imagery Aug 2020

response_variable: Daily 8-h maximum ozone and 24-h mean PM2.5 concentrations
predictor_sources: land use; meteorology; satellite; numerical air-quality simulation (Table S1)
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: California wildfire case study 1 May-30 Sep 2008: 186 ozone monitors (25,236 obs) and 136 PM2.5 monitors (14,247 obs); models fitted per 1/2/4/8-week windows; naive 10-fold CV vs leave-location-out 10-fold (LLO10) and LOLO; buffered LLO CV only in simulation study (50/150 simulated monitors, 100 replicates); linear regression, RF, universal kriging

response_variable: Aboveground biomass density (Mg/ha) from GLAS lidar footprints
predictor_sources: Landsat time series CCDC coefficients (intercept, slope, harmonics, RMSE); predicted reflectance; latitude/longitude
data_quality_controls: Landsat cloud/shadow, radiometric saturation, opacity/aerosol QA filtering; reflectance outside 0-1 removed; BRDF correction; GLAS footprints screened to highest quality; added non-woody points with NDVI>0.5 removed
notes: Northern Amazon basin (Amazonas and Para), annual AGB 1999-2019 at 30 m; 650,707 GLAS-based points (incl. 15,252 non-woody); 80/20 split stratified by AGB range bins (manually rebalanced); leave-one-disc-out CV with 100 km radius test discs (10 random discs, mean 2715 points) and exclusion zones 0-500 km in 50 km steps, max set to semivariogram range; RF, GBM, XGBoost; also compared with independent airborne ALS AGB

response_variable: Vegetation vertical complexity (Shannon entropy of LVIS waveform)
predictor_sources: ABoVE land cover PFTs; HLS optical reflectance/indices; satellite phenology (spring onset, green season length); climate (temperature, precipitation)
data_quality_controls: training points spatially thinned to >=500 m separation; flightlines stratified by ABoVE B-level reference grid; leaf-on summer acquisitions only
notes: ABoVE domain (Alaska and boreal Canada); 93 LVIS flightlines 2017 and 2019; random 5-fold CV and SampVal (20% random hold-out from sampled points) vs FLVal (6 reserved flightlines in external regions, used as spatial validation); four RF predictor configurations; NEON plot data (2015-2019) used only for in situ analysis

response_variable: Soil depth to petrocalcic horizon (tosca), cm, up to 1 m
predictor_sources: Veris ECa (0-30 and 0-90 cm); SRTM elevation, slope, TRI, TPI; neighbourhood means within 15-60 m buffers
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: Eight commercial fields (16-154 ha, total ~681 ha) in southeastern Buenos Aires pampas; soil depth by hydraulic probe at 2-12 points/ha; RF (ranger) tuned with 5-fold CV and evaluated by OOB R2/RMSE vs leave-one-field-out CV; overall and soil-type-specific models

response_variable: Sugarcane yield per field-year (Mg/ha)
predictor_sources: harvest/management records; soil properties; applied inputs; meteorology (incl. land surface temperature)
data_quality_controls: missing data handled by two dataset versions (A: drop incomplete observations, 13,645 obs, 33 predictors; B: drop incomplete attributes, 17,742 obs, 31 predictors); Moran's I check
notes: Four Odebrecht sugarcane mills (SP, MS, GO), 2012-2015, one observation per field per year; ~60% modelling / 20% validation hold-out / 20% manually selected spatially distant independent set; standard protocol randomly assigns observations to 5 CV folds and hold-out, spatial protocol assigns k-means clusters of fields (93 clusters dataset A, 102 dataset B); BRT, RF, SVR with/without RReliefF

response_variable: Topsoil pH, clay (%) and soil organic carbon (g/kg)
predictor_sources: DEM derivatives; climate; land cover; MODIS net primary productivity
data_quality_controls: soil measurement error variances quantified (from duplicate measurements and MIR spectral model error) and accounted for via weighting; samples air-dried, sieved and ground; spectral replicates averaged
notes: Western highlands of Cameroon (1,053 km2); LDSF design with three 10 x 10 km sentinel sites, 160 locations each; 480 topsoil samples (10% conventional lab reference, 90% MIRS-predicted); LOOCV vs leave-cluster-out and leave-site-out CV; RF/QRF vs regression kriging, with/without measurement error

response_variable: Land and snow cover class per pixel (snow, shaded snow, vegetation, water, exposed ground)
predictor_sources: WorldView-2/3 panchromatic and 8-band multispectral; NDVI and normalised difference indices
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: North Cascades (WA) and Grand Mesa (CO) sites, WV images 2015-2019; manually delineated training polygons per image; 70/15/15 train/val/test split with 10-fold random CV (F>99%) vs separate test polygons placed several hundred to several thousand metres from training polygons (F ~94% and ~82%); semivariograms showed autocorrelation; also out-of-region model transfer tests; RF, 155 model configurations

response_variable: Minute-level near-road ultrafine particle number concentration (#/cm3)
predictor_sources: video-derived traffic counts and turning movements; meteorology (weather station); land use and built environment within 50-1000 m buffers
data_quality_controls: records flagged with instrument errors (tilt, inlet flow) removed; UFP outliers removed by 1.5 IQR rule; instrument clocks synchronised daily; computer-vision traffic counts validated against 60 min of manual counts
notes: Hurontario Street, Greater Toronto Area, Feb-May 2019; 24 roadside locations each visited 5 times for 30 min (1-min data); random 10-fold CV on 1-min records vs 3/5/10-min chunked CV vs location-blocked 10-fold CV (2-3 locations per fold); models for all data and two k-means site clusters (13 and 11 locations); XGBoost with SHAP

response_variable: Tree genus floristic composition (NMDS axes 1-3 scores)
predictor_sources: Landsat TM/ETM+ dry-season composite 2000-2009; CHELSA climate; soil (e.g., CEC); elevation
data_quality_controls: plots outside Amazonian ecozones excluded; genus-level identifications used; multi-year cloud-minimised Landsat composite
notes: Peruvian Amazonia (~790,000 km2, <2000 m a.s.l.); 157 INFFS national forest inventory plots (0.5 ha L-shaped) sampled 2013-2018; RF with forward feature selection (CAST); random 10-fold CV vs 5 latitudinally non-overlapping spatial folds; predictions at 450 m classified into 10 floristic classes

response_variable: Daily mean PM2.5 concentration (ug/m3)
predictor_sources: meteorology (temperature, pressure, wind, humidity); SRTM elevation; khoroo-level population, stove density, ger-area and internet proportions, land-use zones; calendar variables
data_quality_controls: daily mean set missing if >25% hourly values missing; meteorology averaged over sites to reduce ~40% predictor missingness; US Embassy data noted as not validated; outlying rural districts without monitors excluded from prediction
notes: Ulaanbaatar 2010-2018; hourly PM2.5 from 9 monitoring stations aggregated to daily; models trained/tuned with LOLO CV (9 folds) on 85% of data and evaluated on a 15% hold-out test set (R2 up to 0.96 vs LOLO 0.82); hold-out split method not described; RF, GBM, SVM, MARS, GAM, kNN; entire period and cold/warm season models

response_variable: Species presence vs pseudo-absence (300 species of mammals, amphibians, freshwater fish)
predictor_sources: WorldClim 1.4 bioclimatic variables (five predictor sets)
data_quality_controls: species retained only if training and test sets each had >=100 presence cells and 10,000 pseudo-absences
notes: Presences from IUCN expert range maps rasterised at 5 arc-min; pseudo-absences (1,000, 10,000 or equal to presences) from surrounding biomes (mammals, amphibians) or catchments (fish); random 80/20 split vs spatially independent test built by alternately assigning biomes/catchments (sorted by record count) to train or test; 100 species per group; GLM, GAM, GBM, RF, MaxEnt, etc. plus ensemble; TSS

response_variable: Daily maximum 8-h average ozone (log ppm)
predictor_sources: WRF-Chem CO, PM2.5 and ozone; OMI NO2 (BEHR); MODIS NDVI and other satellite products; meteorology; land use; latitude/longitude/time
data_quality_controls: ozone log-transformed for heteroscedasticity; covariates standardised
notes: Northern California 2008 wildfire period (6 May-26 Sep 2008), 100 EPA monitors, 13,487 daily observations; random 10-fold CV vs leave-one-location-out CV; ten algorithms (GBM, RF, kNN, neural net, GAM, MARS, lasso, elastic net, etc.); extrapolation check on southern California 2007 wildfire data (72 monitors, 5,978 obs)

response_variable: Daily PM10 concentration (ug/m3)
predictor_sources: MAIAC AOD (Terra/Aqua, gap-filled by RF); meteorology; land cover; population; road network; elevation; other spatial and temporal predictors
data_quality_controls: outliers removed (negative values or beyond 4 x IQR per site); daily values only if >=75% valid hourly data; sites kept with >=70% annual data; missing daily PM10 imputed; missing AOD imputed with stage-1 RF
notes: Gauteng, Mpumalanga, KwaZulu-Natal and Western Cape provinces, year 2016; 18 monitoring sites (measured plus imputed daily PM10); stage-2 RF, GBM and SVR combined in ensemble; random 10-fold CV (R2 0.84) vs leave-location-out CV with sites grouped into 10 folds (R2 0.48); also leave-time-out CV by day of year; 1 km predictions

response_variable: Canopy top height (RH98, m) from airborne laser scanning matched to GEDI footprints
predictor_sources: GEDI L1B full waveforms (normalised); laser power/beam metadata used in analysis
data_quality_controls: GEDI-ALS geolocation correction by waveform matching; poor-quality offsets filtered (<25 shots); samples with waveform Pearson correlation <0.95 rejected; noise level subtracted and energy normalised; training augmentation with random shifts
notes: ALS reference sites in North America, Europe, Africa, Australia and Asia/tropics; random 10-fold CV of deep CNN ensemble (RMSE 3.6 m) vs geographic CV holding out one continental region at a time (Europe, Australia, Africa, tropics); 10% of training set used for early-stopping validation; predictive uncertainty calibration

response_variable: Local climate zone class (LCZ1-10 urban, LCZA-G natural)
predictor_sources: Landsat 5/7/8 seasonal surface reflectance composites smoothed with LandTrendr
data_quality_controls: refined training areas: 249 of 921 crowdsourced polygons modified or deleted for label inconsistency and additional polygons digitised; LandTrendr smoothing to fill cloud/shadow-masked observations; number of training areas capped in over-represented classes
notes: Eight US metropolitan statistical areas, LCZ mapping for 2018; crowdsourced (WUDAPT) vs refined training areas; random 70/30 split of the sample pool vs 70/30 split of the polygon pool (samples drawn within training or testing polygons), each repeated 10 times; RF (pixel-based) and ResNet (scene-based) classifiers

response_variable: Northern Idaho ground squirrel presence vs background (relative habitat suitability)
predictor_sources: soil maps; DEM-derived topography; LANDFIRE vegetation and fire interval; NLCD canopy cover
data_quality_controls: one presence retained per 30-m pixel to avoid pseudo-replication; background drawn within 1.2-km dispersal buffers
notes: Maxent (maxnet); 8878 presences plus background at 1:10 ratio kept within every fold; spatial folds are latitudinal bands (2-fold, 5-fold) or dispersal-barrier units (3-fold) set to mimic extrapolation; surveys 2001-2018; Adams and Valley counties, Idaho

response_variable: hourly near-surface air temperature
predictor_sources: GOES-16/17 LST; MODIS NDVI; DEM (elevation, slope, aspect); land cover (water, urban); ERA5 reanalysis; hour of day
data_quality_controls: ISD station QC (extreme value, consistency, homogeneity checks); stations kept only with >80% record length (>20% in Central America); stations within one grid cell averaged
notes: Random forest; >6.3 million hourly station-samples for 2020; site-based 5-fold CV splits stations randomly into 5 groups; GOES CONUS sector also covers southern Canada, Mexico and Central America (116 sites); station-density bootstrap experiments

response_variable: pluvial flood occurrence (flooded vs non-flooded pixel per event date)
predictor_sources: DTM (aspect, curvature, elevation, slope); ARPAV soil and texture maps; CORINE land cover; Sentinel-2 NDVI; kriged station precipitation; distance to road/river/sea
data_quality_controls: heavy-rain pluvial events only (riverine/coastal floods excluded); non-flooded pixels subsampled to 10000 per date; features rescaled
notes: LR, NN, RF; inner R-CV (4 folds, balanced flooded pixels) vs inner leave-location-and-time-out CV (9 folds) nested inside an outer LLTO-CV with 16 folds (4 latitude groups x 4 time periods); outer test fold is separated in space and time; 60 events 1995-2020 from citizen/firefighter reports; 231420 flooded pixels

response_variable: annual wild mushroom productivity
predictor_sources: interpolated daily climate from 201 stations (meteoland); LiDAR-derived elevation, slope, aspect, basal area; CORINE habitats map
data_quality_controls: none_reported
notes: RF, XGB, SVM, ANN vs GLMM and GWR; permanent plots sampled weekly 1997-2019 and aggregated to annual values; spatial CV via mlr3spatiotempcv, partition method not stated; environmental blocking also tested; Catalonia

response_variable: black carbon and particle number concentrations (bicycle mobile monitoring)
predictor_sources: land use; transportation network; natural environment (tree canopy, water); RTMA meteorology; hour of day
data_quality_controls: multiplicative background adjustment from a central site; log transform; +1 ug/m3 offset for zero/negative BC; 100-m median spatial aggregation; removal of predictors with r>0.8
notes: Nine ML algorithms; daily average model n=423, hourly n=5076, one-second BC n=319490 and PN n=354717; k-means clusters built on land-use/transport variables (not coordinates), k chosen by elbow method; spatio-temporal CV also used for 1-s models; summer-fall 2016, Blacksburg VA, two 20-km routes

response_variable: vegetation height (airborne LiDAR top-of-canopy p100)
predictor_sources: ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 ScanSAR L-band mosaics (24); PALSAR-2 FBD annual mosaics
data_quality_controls: multi-temporal speckle filtering; aggregation to 100 m; histogram matching of training/test height distributions in spatial split
notes: Random forest; about 150000 1-ha LiDAR samples (G-LiHT 2013); random split stratified by 3-m height classes; spatial split by k-means on coordinates (sperrorest), number of clusters not reported; Yucatan peninsula, area >100000 km2 so coded national

response_variable: land-cover class of image objects (9 classes)
predictor_sources: CIR aerial photography spectral and texture variables; soil maps; topography; climate
data_quality_controls: image pre-processing per O'Connell et al. 2013; object segmentation in eCognition
notes: Random forest; within-site kappa (self-kappa, source=target, procedure in Appendix S1) vs transfer kappa to the 9 other sites (90 pairs); sites 1197-15136 ha; ground truth 6.5% of objects; imagery 2006-2010; 30 RF repetitions

response_variable: summer median land surface temperature (Landsat)
predictor_sources: Landsat 8/9 NDVI and NDBI; MODIS MCD43A3 albedo
data_quality_controls: cloud cover <40%; QA_PIXEL cloud, shadow, cirrus and snow masking; check for missing and inconsistent records
notes: MLR, RF, GBR; also 70/30 train-test split; 5 spatial blocks formed from standardized lat/lon; 500-m grid; summer 2024 with 2023 repeat run; Sofia municipality (1311 km2)

response_variable: vascular plant species richness
predictor_sources: SRTM elevation and slope; CHIRPS precipitation; FLDAS shortwave radiation; DEA land cover distances; TERN soil properties
data_quality_controls: plots kept only if >=70% native and >=90% identified to species; aggregation to 10-km grid; variable selection re-estimated within training folds
notes: RF with GCF feature expansion and six other learners; 4989 plots (Mokany et al. 2022) aggregated to 958 cells; 38 occupied blocks, side length 2x residual variogram range (66 km); a leave-region-out (west/central/east) robustness test also run; SWAFR >100000 km2 so coded national

response_variable: phytoplankton functional type chlorophyll a (8 PFTs)
predictor_sources: OC-CCI ocean colour (gap-filled with DCT-PLS); SST; SSS; Copernicus Marine biogeochemistry; spatiotemporal variables
data_quality_controls: duplicate samples averaged; multiple HPLC samples within one 4-km cell averaged; diagnostic pigment analysis
notes: Ensemble of 100 ResNets (STEE-DL); global HPLC database 1998-2023 from SeaBASS, PANGAEA, BODC, AODN; hexagonal blocks at 20 deg; temporal-block CV also used; six long-term time-series stations held out for independent validation

response_variable: paddy rice yield (kg/m2, ubin harvest)
predictor_sources: UAV RGB colour moments and GLCM texture; UAV multispectral NDVI (three growth stages)
data_quality_controls: radiometric calibration with reflectance target; NDVI clipped to [-1,1]; plot boundaries clipped centrally to avoid edge contamination
notes: SVR, RF, XGBoost, MLP; 5x5 nested CV; leave-one-block-out over 8 farm blocks; single season 2025; 2.714 ha site in Lamongan, East Java

response_variable: Arctic clam (Mya) presence-absence and abundance from underwater images
predictor_sources: multibeam bathymetry and terrain derivatives; multibeam backscatter; sediment grain-size models
data_quality_controls: images graded by quality (abundance only from high-quality images); predictors with Spearman rho>=0.7 removed
notes: Boosted regression trees (gbm.step internal 10-fold CV); presence-absence n=2273, abundance n=1985; Mya present in 84% of images; buffer = directional variogram major range of residuals; Qikiqtarjuaq, Nunavut

response_variable: 20 soil properties at standard depths
predictor_sources: DEM topography; PRISM climate; MODIS; Landsat; aeroradiometric grids; land cover; potential natural vegetation; surficial geology
data_quality_controls: georeferencing quality tiers; harmonisation of EC and gypsum methods by regression; training sources retained by relative prediction interval
notes: SOLUS 100 m maps; training from SCD lab pedons, NASIS field pedons linked to SSURGO components and gNATSGO map-unit estimates (about 255000 pedon locations across tiers; n varies by property); block size chosen per property by matching cvRPI to gRPI

response_variable: forest type (coniferous vs broadleaf)
predictor_sources: Sentinel-2 bands B2, B3, B4, B8 (four dates 2016)
data_quality_controls: pure stands only; NDVI<0.4 masking of changed stands; 20-m inward buffer; stands <1 ha removed; cloud gap-filling
notes: RF; reference from IGN BD Foret; up to 1972 stands per class in Herault (pixel- and object-level designs); non-spatial LOO also run; buffer from Moran's I correlogram (19.74 km in text, 19.64 km in Fig. 9); independent validation in Tarn and Aveyron departments

response_variable: aboveground woody biomass (Mg/ha)
predictor_sources: CHELSA climate; TerraClimate water deficit, VPD and PET; 30 arc-s topography
data_quality_controls: harmonised minimum DBH >=3 cm; common allometric equation
notes: Random forest; inventory plots from ForestPlots.net and other sources; spatial CV groups plots into spatially disjoint folds by coordinates, method and k not stated; Caatinga biome

response_variable: daily mean near-surface air temperature
predictor_sources: MODIS Terra/Aqua LST; GLASS radiation, albedo and LAI; GMTED2010 elevation; GLDAS assimilated air temperature
data_quality_controls: station data under strict QC; MODIS LST QC flags; temporal gap-filling of cloudy LST
notes: Three RF models by sky condition; 3:1:1 train/validation/test split of 2003-2016 pairs; leave-location-out with 7 geographic station clusters following Xiao et al. 2018; leave-time-out (14 years) also used; 2010 product compared with CLDAS, CMFD and GLDAS

response_variable: tree species richness, Shannon and Simpson diversity
predictor_sources: GEDI L2A/L2B structure metrics; WorldClim bioclimate; elevation
data_quality_controls: plots without valid coordinates or live trees excluded; GEDI footprints averaged within 500-m buffer to handle FIA coordinate fuzzing (250/1000 m sensitivity)
notes: OLS, Ridge, RF, GBM; FIA plots 2019-2022 in CA, OR and WA; leave-one-latitudinal-band-out with five ~3.26 deg bands of unequal size (n=250 to 4127)

response_variable: shallow landslide release (landslide vs control point)
predictor_sources: 5-m DEM and derivatives; NGU bedrock, superficial deposits and deposit thickness maps; soil condition map; seNorge and MET Nordic precipitation; land use and forest attribute maps
data_quality_controls: inventory from Sentinel-2 dNDVI validated with orthophotos, drone and field checks; debris floods excluded; starting points re-evaluated; records with NA predictors removed
notes: GPBoost; 570 landslides and 568 controls (forest-only 339/434); k=5 or 4 depending on data; large blocks (5 in one column) and 8x8 checkerboard small blocks also tested; storm Hans, August 2023, southern Norway

response_variable: urban ground collapse occurrence (event vs background control)
predictor_sources: Copernicus DEM derivatives; ERA5-Land rainfall (1, 3, 7, 30 days); drainage pipeline attributes; OSM roads, rivers and metro; NDVI; engineering-geological map; simulated inundation
data_quality_controls: records without valid coordinates or dates dropped; duplicates removed; 150-m exclusion buffer for controls (50-200 m sensitivity); pseudo-date sensitivity (20 repeats)
notes: RF, XGBoost, LightGBM; 1687 collapses with 1:5 controls; split stratified by label and year; leave-one-district-out (number of districts not stated); forward temporal hold-out 2017-2021 train vs 2022-2024 test; Shenzhen built-up domain 1234.14 km2
